jobs.title: Senior Privacy Specialist
jobs.description:
About Us:

Fireworks is the platform for specialized intelligence, enabling companies to build, train, and serve AI models tailored to their own data, workflows, and products. Founded by the team behind PyTorch and backed by AMD, Atreides, Benchmark Capital, Index Ventures, Lightspeed, NVIDIA, Sequoia Capital, and TCV, Fireworks powers production AI with hundreds of state-of-the-art open models across text, image, embedding, audio, and multimodal workloads. Today, Fireworks is a Series D company valued at $17.5 billion, bringing together an ambitious, collaborative team that's building the future of enterprise AI.

About the role

We're hiring a Senior Privacy Specialist to be our privacy presence in the UK and EU as Fireworks scales its European footprint. We've achieved ISO 27001, ISO 27701, ISO 42001, and SOC 2 Type II, and we operate active UK GDPR, EU GDPR, and CCPA programs.

You'll be our senior privacy point of contact for the UK and EU - the person who fields supervisory authority correspondence and owns the operational processes that keep our UK GDPR, EU GDPR, and Data Protection Act 2018 obligations met. You'll report to our Privacy Lead and work as part of a small global privacy team, with real autonomy over the UK/EU side of the program.

This is a hands-on senior individual contributor role, and an advisory one. You'll be the privacy judgment in the room for the UK and EU: the person engineers, sales, and legal come to before they ship, sign, or answer.

Who this role is for

We're building a privacy function that punches well above its headcount. That shapes who succeeds here:

  • You've operated and built under ambiguity. You're used to being the one who owns it, and you've built structures where none existed rather than inheriting someone else's.

  • You build systems, not queues. You've used AI tooling, automation platforms, scripting, or workflow engines to take manual privacy work off the table - and you're excited to do more of that utilizing cutting-edge technology.

  • You take a project and finish it. You don't need prescriptive instructions or hand-holding - you spot what's broken, scope it, own it until completion, and socialize it within the organization.

  • You take extreme ownership. When something in your area goes wrong, you own it, fix it, and make sure it can't happen the same way twice - without waiting to be asked and without pointing fingers.

What you'll do

  • Act as our senior privacy point of contact for the UK and EU: first line for the ICO and EU supervisory authorities, handling regulator correspondence and inquiries with support from our Privacy Lead and Legal.

  • Be the standing privacy advisor for the region: guidance to product, engineering, GTM, and Legal on what UK/EU law permits, where the grey areas are, and what risk you're recommending we accept.

  • Own UK/EU data subject rights outcomes: statutory deadlines, scope and exemption decisions, edge cases, and the regional record.

  • Own cross-border transfer compliance: UK IDTA and Addendum, EU SCCs, adequacy analysis, and Transfer Impact Assessments for vendors, sub-processors, and intra-group flows.

  • Lead breach assessment and notification for UK/EU: triage, 72-hour notification decisions, regulator and data subject communications, and post-incident follow-through with Security and Legal.

  • Embed privacy-by-design into how we build: review new products, features, models, and vendors for privacy risk, and give engineering and product teams guidance they can act on.

  • Partner with our AI governance work on privacy in model training, fine-tuning, and inference - data minimization, purpose limitation, customer data handling, and emerging EU AI Act obligations.

  • Keep the UK/EU privacy notice and policy library accurate, practical, and aligned to what we actually do and our regulatory obligations.

  • Take on additional privacy projects as the program evolves; we're a growing team with dynamic priorities.

How the role will grow

As the program matures and our European footprint expands, you'll have the opportunity to:

  • Regional ownership - take on privacy for additional jurisdictions as we enter new markets, and shape our approach to emerging regimes.

  • Advisory reach - become the privacy voice in the highest-stakes decisions: new markets, new product categories, regulator engagement, and AI Act readiness.

  • Program ownership - take a hand in setting program direction, roadmap, and strategy.

What we're looking for

  • 5-7 years of experience in privacy or data protection, with meaningful time in a tech, SaaS, or cloud company.

  • Deep, hands-on working knowledge of UK GDPR, EU GDPR, and the Data Protection Act 2018 - you've been a key player in a program complying with these regimes, not just worked on a small portion of one.

  • Experience as the sole or primary privacy owner for a region, product, or company; you're comfortable without a large team around you.

  • Track record running DPIAs and DSARs hands-on, and advising product and engineering teams on privacy-by-design.

  • Direct experience with international transfer mechanisms (UK IDTA, SCCs, adequacy, TIAs) and the judgment to apply them to real vendor and architecture decisions.

  • Some exposure to a supervisory authority - whether as a DPO, deputy, or otherwise.

  • Excellent communication; you work confidently across engineering, legal, sales, and executive audiences, and you can turn regulatory requirements into clear guidance.

  • Comfort with low-code automation and LLM-based tooling - enough to specify, evaluate, and get hands-on with the systems that run your program.

  • Based in the EU/UK with the right to work in those geographies.

Nice to have

  • Privacy certifications (CIPP/E, CIPM, CIPT, FIP).

  • Experience with privacy tooling (OneTrust, TrustArc, Transcend, DataGrail, Securiti, or similar) - especially if you've pushed one past its out-of-the-box limits.

  • Exposure to ISO 42001, AI/ML data governance, model training data considerations, or the EU AI Act.

  • Experience standing up a privacy function in-region at a growth-stage company.

Why Fireworks?

  • Solve Hard Problems: Tackle challenges at the forefront of AI infrastructure, from low-latency inference to scalable model serving.

  • Build What’s Next: Work with bleeding-edge technology that impacts how businesses and developers harness AI globally.

  • Ownership & Impact: Join a fast-growing, passionate team where your work directly shapes the future of AI—no bureaucracy, just results.

  • Learn from the Best: Collaborate with world-class engineers and AI researchers who thrive on curiosity and innovation.

Fireworks AI is an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all innovators.

jobs.title: Product Designer
jobs.description:
The Role

 

We're hiring Product Designers to help shape how enterprises understand, govern, and trust their AI agents.

 

Geordie is building category-defining tooling for agent visibility, governance, and risk. The design challenge is real: AI agent behaviour is complex, often opaque, and the stakes for our customers are high.

 

Our design team is small today; you'll report into our Head of Product Design and join two Product Designers. We have three development teams, growing to five, and we believe design works best embedded. You'll join one of those teams as its designer, working alongside its engineers and customers every day. Because we're still early, you'll also help set the foundation everything else is built on: the design language, the component library, and the patterns we use across the product. Our design team also looks after Geordie's brand, so you'll help shape how we show up beyond the product too, making sure brand and product feel like one coherent experience.

 

Design here isn't a layer applied at the end. We ship multiple times a day, and we actively encourage designers to use AI agents to write code and get closer to the product. We don't have Product Managers; design and engineering partner directly to figure out what to build. Our engineers are deeply product-minded, close to customers, and want to solve the right problem rather than ship to spec. Together you'll define problems, shape scope, and own outcomes. If you've ever wanted to own something end to end, this is it.

 

We also move fast. We ship multiple times a day, and we actively encourage designers to use AI agents to write code and get closer to the product. If you've ever wanted to own something end to end, this is it.

 
 
 
 

What You'll Do

 

Own the end-to-end design of core product experiences, from early concept through to shipped and iterated.

 

Help build Geordie's design system with the rest of the design team; the tokens, components, patterns, and documentation that everyone relies on, shaped by what your team needs.

 

Contribute to Geordie's brand; helping evolve our visual language, illustration, and assets so the product and brand tell one story.

 

Lead customer discovery and research; running interviews, identifying patterns, and bringing customer insight into every design decision.

 

Work directly with customers to test your thinking early and close the loop between insight and shipped product.

 

Collaborate daily with engineers; pairing, reviewing, and increasingly using AI tools to prototype and contribute to the codebase yourself.

 

Contribute to product direction: you will be in the room where decisions are made, not handed a spec to execute.

 

Keep a strong point of view on what good design looks like in a security and governance product; clear, trustworthy, and built for expert users.

 
 
 

What We're Looking For

 

The most important thing is that you care deeply about customers and can move fast without losing quality. You are a strong practitioner; you can go from whiteboard to high-fidelity quickly, and you know when each is appropriate.

 

You are comfortable with ambiguity. We are Series A, the product is evolving, and the domain of AI agent governance is genuinely new. You find that energising, not unsettling.

 

You have strong opinions about design systems and component architecture, and experience building or significantly contributing to one. You can articulate why decisions were made and defend them clearly.

 

You work well in a collaborative engineering culture. You are comfortable pair-designing with engineers, reviewing pull requests for design quality, and using AI tools to accelerate your own work.

 
 

Requirements

 

Significant experience as a product designer, with a portfolio that demonstrates complex UX problem-solving; not just polished visuals.

 

Experience designing highly complex B2B SaaS products, including data visualisation and data-dense interfaces; you can turn large volumes of information into something expert users can understand and act on.

 

Proven ability to work across the full design process: research, concept, detailed design, and handoff.

 

Strong product thinking; you can define the problem, question the brief, and help decide what to build, not just how it should look.

 

Strong communication and collaboration skills; you can align stakeholders, present work with clarity, and receive feedback well.

 

Comfortable working in a fast-moving, iterative environment where requirements evolve quickly.

 
 
 

Nice to Haves

 

Experience designing for security, developer, or enterprise SaaS products.

 

Familiarity with AI agent tooling, observability platforms, or data-dense interfaces.

 

Experience contributing to a design system, including tokens, components, and documentation.

 

Experience working on brand or visual identity, such as illustration, iconography, or marketing design.

 

Experience writing code, even basic frontend, or using AI tools to prototype in the browser.

 

Background working at an early-stage startup where you built things from scratch.

 
 
 

Why This Role

 

AI agents are changing how companies operate, and the question of how to govern them safely is only going to grow. Geordie is building the platform enterprises rely on to answer that question.

 

You will join at a point where design is still being defined. There is no legacy system to work around, no established playbook to follow; just a hard problem, a sharp team, and a genuine opportunity to shape how a new category is understood.

 

You will work with real customers, see the impact of your work quickly, and have the scope to grow as the company does.

 
 

Our Values

 

Solve What Matters

 

We listen intently and stay focused on what truly matters to our customers. If it doesn't help them navigate real-world agentic adoption and risk, it's probably not worth building.

 

Build, Learn, Iterate

 

We favour momentum over perfection; testing, learning, and evolving through action. It's how we move fast and get better, together.

 

Kind, Not Comfortable

 

We're honest, respectful, and unafraid to challenge each other. We believe doing great work should feel good, too. Kindness makes that possible.

 

A Platform for Your Best Work

 

We want this to be the most meaningful chapter of your career. Geordie is the place where you grow, lead and lift others, while building something that truly matters.

jobs.title: Cyber Exposure Management Expert (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
It all starts with the mission: NVISO is here to protect European society from potentially devastating cyber attacks. This means we offer cyber security services to private and governmental organizations to help them better prepare for, prevent, detect and respond to cyber security incidents. All of this is built on four fundamental values that define who we are: We are Proud, We Break Barriers, We Care and No BS!

Tasks

As Cyber Exposure Management Expert (m/w/d) located in Germany, you will be the technical lead for developing NVISO's Cyber Exposure offering. You will define how Vulnerability Management, Asset Management, hardening, Patch Management, reporting and remediation work together through clear processes and responsibilities, and guide the technical decisions that make the service work for our clients.

You will be the expert clients and colleagues turn to for the complete picture: which assets matter, where they are exposed, who needs to act and whether remediation has worked. You will design the processes, integrations and reporting that connect these questions, lead complex customer engagements and help other consultants deliver the service. You will advise on hardening and help clients establish ownership, remediation targets and a process that fits their IT operations.

You will also shape what we build next. Starting from our existing Vulnerability Management capabilities, you will develop the technical roadmap towards Continuous Threat Exposure Management (CTEM) and assess where Attack Surface analysis, exposure validation and Quantum Readiness belong in the offering. This gives you room to propose solutions, build prototypes and test them with clients before turning them into repeatable services.

Typical responsibilities include:

  • Defining the technical architecture and delivery approach for the Cyber Exposure offering, connecting Vulnerability Management, Asset Management, hardening, Patch Management, reporting and remediation, with clear roles and governance;
  • Leading technical delivery on customer engagements, advising on remediation and hardening, resolving design and integration problems and reviewing the quality of our work;
  • Linking vulnerability findings to asset inventories, CMDBs, cloud environments, business services and owners, and resolving gaps in coverage and data quality;
  • Designing remediation processes with owners, priorities, SLAs, escalation, risk acceptance and closure checks, aligned with Change Management and supported by ITSM, Patch Management and other remediation solutions;
  • Building reporting that shows clients their exposure and remediation progress, with clear priorities for technical teams and reliable measures of coverage, ageing, SLA performance and accepted risk for management;
  • Advising on secure configurations and hardening baselines for infrastructure and cloud environments, reducing unnecessary exposure and proposing compensating controls when patching is not immediately possible;
  • Keeping up with developments in Exposure Management and evaluating AI and agentic solutions through targeted pilots to improve existing approaches to prioritization, remediation guidance and reporting. You will test accuracy and usefulness, protect client data and define human oversight, including approval before AI recommendations trigger remediation actions;
  • Turning client needs into service packages, technical standards and delivery methods, coaching consultants and providing technical input for proposals and scoping;
  • Developing the service roadmap and evaluating new capabilities through pilots, including CTEM, Attack Surface analysis and cryptographic discovery, Crypto Agility and Post Quantum Cryptography migration planning. You will help decide which capabilities are ready to become services and what we need to deliver them well.

Requirements

  • You hold citizenship in one of the 32 NATO member states or the Austrian citizenship;
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in a relevant field, or equivalent professional experience;
  • Strong practical experience in Vulnerability Management, including scanning platforms, prioritization based on asset criticality and exploitability, and remediation processes, with the ability to guide technical decisions on customer engagements;
  • Understanding of enterprise infrastructure, networking and cloud environments, with practical experience advising on secure configurations, hardening baselines and compensating controls;
  • Experience connecting security findings with asset inventories, CMDBs or Asset Management platforms, including ownership mapping and improving data quality;
  • Experience designing security dashboards and management reports that make priorities, progress and data limitations clear;
  • Experience designing remediation processes across security and IT teams, including ownership, SLAs, exceptions and Change Management. Familiarity with ITSM and remediation platforms is expected; scripting and API skills are an advantage;
  • Ability to design a solution across several tools and processes, explain the technical choices and guide colleagues through implementation. Experience developing a consulting service is an advantage;
  • Interest in developing CTEM and Quantum Readiness services and testing AI applications in security operations. Experience evaluating AI or agentic solutions is an advantage. Experience with Attack Surface analysis, Crypto Agility or Post Quantum Cryptography is welcome; you do not need to be an expert in every area on day one;
  • Fluent business English and professional fluency in the relevant local language(s).

Benefits

  • Working and learning from the best people in the European cyber security industry. We have multiple SANS Instructors working at NVISO, our staff has presented at popular hacking conferences (BlackHat, BruCON, OWASP, etc) and all of our technical staff can acquire deep technical security certifications (GSE, GXPN, GREM, GCFA, OSCP, etc);
  • Generous training budget of 10.000 EUR + 10 man days for attending lectures rolling over 2 years;
  • Base salary range (depending on experience and skillset): 70.000 EUR p.a. – 100.000 EUR p.a.;
  • Regular team-building and fun events;
  • Our commitment to coach and counsel you and help you grow; each employee receives a personal coach within the team, whose role is to ensure your well-being and helps you grow in your career!
  • Flexible working hours and home office possibilities (incl. working abroad weeks within the EU);
  • Business Bike Leasing;
  • BahnCard 50 1st class + public transfer ticket or EGYM WellPass;
  • 30 holidays;
  • Company Pension Scheme;
  • Cool offices in the center of Frankfurt, Munich and Vienna (with BBQ, kicker table, table tennis, playstations, etc.).

Disclaimer on the Use of AI Tools in the Application Process

Please be aware that the creation and submission of application documents (e.g. CV, cover letter, case studies, etc.) using AI-powered tools is only permitted to a limited extent.

Our expectations:

  • Application documents must authentically reflect your own qualifications, personality, and motivation.
  • The use of AI for supportive purposes (e.g. spell-checking, improving wording) is acceptable.
  • Fully generated application documents created by AI without personal adaptation or review are not permitted.
  • Under no circumstances may NVISO information, data, or documents be uploaded to or processed by external AI tools.

We reserve the right to exclude applications from the selection and interview process that are clearly created primarily or exclusively by AI and show no recognizable personal input.

The purpose of this policy is to ensure a fair and transparent recruitment process and to obtain an authentic impression of our applicants.

jobs.title: Performance Marketing Manager (m/w/d)
jobs.description:

Qualifikation

  • Deutsch auf C2-Niveau: Du sprichst und schreibst Deutsch sicher und überzeugend, denn unsere Kunden sitzen in DACH.
  • Erfahrung: Du hast bereits Paid-Search- oder Paid-Social-Kampagnen mit vier- bis fünfstelligen Monatsbudgets aufgebaut und gesteuert.
  • Arbeitsweise: Du arbeitest analytisch, proaktiv und lösungsorientiert.
  • Motivation: Du willst mit erfahrenen Leuten Werbeaccounts für führende B2B-Unternehmen mit fünf- bis sechsstelligen Monatsbudgets aufbauen und steuern.

Benefits

  • Coaching & Karriere: Ab Tag 1 lernst du in 1:1-Coachings von erfahrenen Leuten. Und weil wir so schnell wachsen, entstehen laufend neue Fach- und Führungsrollen.

  • Strategy-Offsites: Regelmäßig nehmen wir uns als ganzes Team raus und arbeiten gemeinsam an der Strategie und Zukunft von Arvana.
  • Kostenlos trainieren: Mit der Urban Sports Club M-Mitgliedschaft trainierst du ohne Zusatzkosten.

Bereit mit uns die deutsche B2B-Software Branche zu entwickeln?

Sneak Peek: So läuft dein Bewerbungsprozess bei Arvana ab

1. Kurzes Kennenlernen
Nach deiner Bewerbung melden wir uns schnell bei dir. In einem 10-minütigen Call schauen wir, ob es grundsätzlich passt, und machen direkt den nächsten Termin aus.

2. Personal Fit
Im zweiten Gespräch (ca. 30–45 Minuten) lernen wir dich richtig kennen und erfahren, was dich antreibt. Gleichzeitig zeigen wir dir, wie wir bei Arvana arbeiten, und beantworten all deine Fragen.

3. Case Study vor Ort & Meet the Team
In unserem Office in der Rosenstraße 17 gehst du live mit uns durch einen echten Google-Ads-Account und zeigst uns, wie du ihn analysierst. Dabei lernst du unsere Gründer Arne und Mirco persönlich kennen und kannst mit dem Team quatschen. In ca. 90 Minuten nehmen wir dich mit in unsere Prozesse, unsere Mission und unseren Business-Plan. Danach melden wir uns innerhalb von 2 Tagen bei dir.

jobs.title: Head of Business Development / Business Development Manager (m/w/d) - Telco & Carrier
jobs.description:
At a glance:

  • Salary: €70,000–90,000 base plus variable compensation at 100% target achievement
  • Full-time, hybrid: office in Cologne's Belgian Quarter plus home office
  • Your role: You build our business development from scratch – with a direct line to the managing directors
  • Lots of travel: industry events, trade fairs and associations, national and international
  • Your field: network operators & authorities – lawful interception

The charm of a diplomat, the curiosity of an investigator, the network of a secret agent – that's how we described this role internally.

It sounds exaggerated, but it's remarkably accurate: at ICS International Carrier Services, we work at the intersection of law enforcement agencies and telecommunications providers – lawful interception, a highly sensitive field where trust is the real currency.

And this market is moving: we are internationalizing rapidly, new communication services such as satellite connectivity are opening entirely new fields, and enquiries are growing faster than our calendars.

That's why we're looking for you – not to fill a position, but to build the commercial side of a fast-growing player that is seizing its international opportunities right now. We are a highly motivated team that wants to achieve something big together – and that's exactly the energy we expect from you.

Why ICS

  • Globally connected: We operate at the forefront of lawful interception in a global market – and are deeply networked across the LI world
  • Own technology, approved by authorities: Our proprietary software stack makes us extremely fast, remarkably adaptable and highly competitive on pricing – and it has been audited and approved multiple times by the German Federal Network Agency (BNetzA) and other international authorities
  • Shaping the standards: We contribute to the global standards of our industry in the ETSI working groups
  • Profitable and growing: We are profitable and growing strongly – the ongoing internationalization is your growth opportunity
  • Experienced team: A top engineering team and a management with over 20 years of telco experience
  • Insider knowledge: A market largely hidden from the public: outsiders don't know it, and much of the information – especially on the law enforcement side – simply isn't public. Being on the inside is an advantage you can't google

Tasks

You build our business development – as Head of, initially without a team, working directly with the managing directors. One thing upfront: this is not a classic sales role – it's B2B relationship work, winning new customers through trust rather than cold outreach.

  • Industry presence: You represent us at industry events, trade fairs and association meetings – nationally and internationally. You are where the industry is
  • Relationships with network operators: You build and maintain long-term relationships with telcos, mobile and fixed-line operators, MVNOs, ISPs and carriers – key account and partner management at its best
  • Spotting opportunities: You watch the market and spot opportunities long before they become concrete projects – and open the doors to them
  • Building the strategy: You develop our business development strategy and the processes behind it from scratch
  • Opening conversations: You lead initial conversations and drive opportunities through to handover to the managing directors

Requirements

We care less about your CV – we care about how you connect with people. No technical background required – our topics are highly technical, but we can teach the details. Curiosity and a quick mind, however, can't be taught.

And you don't need to have done this role for years: it doesn't exist at ICS yet, and it can grow with you. What you do need is the desire to do it – and the courage to approach people you don't know yet.

  • You genuinely love people. Not as a phrase, but for real: building and nurturing relationships isn't a job for you, it's your nature
  • Networking is your strength: you never wait to be approached at an event – and after one evening you've made more valuable contacts than others do in an entire trade-fair week
  • C-level communication is not a bonus skill for you – it's part of the game: you engage as a peer with CEOs, managing directors and decision-makers at telcos, ISPs and carriers – as well as at industry associations and events
  • You are outgoing without being artificial: open, authentic, trustworthy
  • Drive: You are highly motivated and want to build something big with us – going through the motions isn't how we work, in either direction
  • Languages: You communicate at full professional proficiency in German and English
  • Entrepreneurial: You work independently, think entrepreneurially and want to build something, not administer it

Helpful but not a must: experience in business development, key account management or partner management – or a background in regulation, association work, consulting or the public-authority sector.

A real plus: an existing network among telcos, ISPs, MVNOs and carriers – ideally international. Nice to have: contacts with law enforcement and security agencies internationally – the agency side is becoming a growing field for us as well.

Absolute reliability and discretion are a given – even when an authority takes a closer look.

Benefits

  • Salary: €70,000–90,000 base. On top of that comes variable compensation of €60,000 at full target achievement. How we measure success, we'll define together with you – in a market you can't find in any database, there's no other way.
  • Real ownership: you build a function from zero – with a direct line to the managing directors, no corporate hierarchy
  • International events and travel: you're out where the industry meets
  • Hybrid: office in Cologne's vibrant Belgian Quarter plus home office – you largely manage your own calendar
  • Team: A small, highly motivated team with short decision paths that wants to achieve something big together
  • Stories to tell: A work environment you can tell stories about at your next dinner party (at least the parts you're allowed to share)

Sound like you? Then let's talk. No cover letter needed – send us your CV and two or three sentences on why this role appeals to you. Or even better: tell us about a contact you made when it seemed impossible. If there's a general fit, we'll start with a confidential conversation.

jobs.title: Scientist, Model Validation and Experimental Data Analysis
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant.

Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.

Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.


TEAM AND ROLE

  • Shape the architecture of the world’s first commercial fusion power plant – Own system-level decisions that determine how a first-of-a-kind energy technology is designed, integrated, and ultimately deployed at scale.

  • Solve some of the most complex engineering challenges in industry – Work across tightly coupled disciplines (plasma physics, magnets, cryogenics, manufacturing, controls, and more) to resolve critical trade-offs and turn cutting-edge science into a functioning product.

  • Build real hardware with a pragmatic, fast-moving team from all over the world – Combine advanced simulation and systems thinking with a strong execution mindset, focusing on practical engineering solutions that accelerate the path to commercial fusion energy.

WHY JOIN PROXIMA FUSION

  • You will get to work on some of the most complex tech challenges to bring abundant, safe, clean energy to the world.

  • You'll get to join and learn from an exceptional selection of accomplished and driven individuals.

  • Do your life’s best work and enjoy the journey.

  • Get to show that big things are possible in Europe when you assemble the best talent.

YOUR IMPACT

You will make Proxima's plasma simulation stack trustworthy by confronting it with reality. Every prediction we make for Alpha – Proxima's Q>1 experimental stellarator – and for Stellaris, our commercial power plant, rests on models whose credibility has to be earned against real measurements from an operating device.

W7-X is where we earn it. You will take our integrated modeling framework, FUS3, and our Bayesian plasma state estimation workflow to W7-X data: reconstruct the plasma state from diagnostic measurements, compare our predictive models against what the machine actually did, and turn the discrepancies into a prioritized map of where our physics is right, where it is not, and what we must fix before Alpha's first plasma. Modeling sits on Alpha's operational critical path and cannot be backfilled after first plasma – this role is how we get ahead of it.

You will be the person in the group who lives at the intersection of modeling and experiment: fluent enough in the physics to know what a model should predict, and close enough to the diagnostics to know what the data can actually support.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Validate Proxima's predictive plasma models against W7-X experimental data – neoclassical and turbulent transport, 3D equilibrium, ECRH deposition, pellet fueling and drift, bootstrap current and iota evolution – and record each comparison as a reproducible validation report with quantitative agreement metrics, stated limitations, and a pinned regression test

  • Reconstruct the plasma state from real diagnostic measurements using our time-dependent Bayesian state-estimation workflow (Thomson scattering, interferometry, CXRS, ECE, XICS, bolometry, magnetics), with calibrated uncertainties, and benchmark it against established analyses such as Minerva/IDA reconstructions and ASTRA power-balance results

  • Work with raw and pre-processed diagnostic data, not just analyzed profiles – instrument geometry, sightlines, calibrations and the caveats that come with them – and own the forward models, noise models and profile fits that feed transport analysis

  • Validate against databases of discharges rather than single shots, across W7-X magnetic configurations and operating regimes, so the output is a map of model applicability and parameter trends rather than one-off discrepancy reports

  • Act as a technical interface to W7-X and IPP: scope and prioritize data requests, spend time on site in Greifswald working alongside diagnosticians and operators, and propose and support experiments that directly target our model gaps

  • Feed validation back into design – convert diagnostic placement and observability studies on W7-X into requirements for Alpha's diagnostic set, and into realistic uncertainty models for the synthetic measurements we use to design against

  • Extend the modeling stack itself: mappers from experimental archives into IMAS, synthetic diagnostics, and analysis workflows, so that interpreting a shot end-to-end – raw data to reconstructed plasma state to physics quantities – runs in minutes and is reproducible by anyone in the group

  • As Alpha approaches operation, help stand up the between-shot analysis loop that will run on day one

WHO YOU ARE

  • PhD in plasma physics, fusion science, or a closely related discipline

  • Hands-on experience with experimental data from a magnetic confinement device – you have dealt with diagnostics, calibrations, systematic errors, and all the ways real data is messier than simulation output

  • Experience reconstructing the plasma state from measurements: profile fitting, integrated data analysis, equilibrium reconstruction, or power and particle balance analysis

  • Strong grounding in transport, equilibrium, and heating physics – enough to tell a code bug from a physics discovery

  • Rigorous about uncertainty; you treat a validation claim without error bars on both sides as incomplete

  • Comfortable writing and maintaining scientific software – version control, testing, and reproducibility are habits, not overhead

  • Can communicate effectively with physicists, diagnosticians, engineers, and experimentalists, and work productively inside an external collaboration

  • Self-directed; able to identify what needs to be done and execute

  • Willing to travel regularly to Greifswald, and later to the Alpha site

NICE TO HAVE

  • W7-X experience - operations, diagnostics, or data analysis, and familiarity with the W7-X data archive and Minerva

  • Stellarator physics background

  • Bayesian inference, uncertainty quantification, or machine learning applied to experimental data

  • Experience with integrated modeling and transport codes (FUSE, OMFIT, ASTRA, TRANSP, FUSE, JINTRAC, or similar) and with neoclassical (SFINCS, DKES, NEO) or gyrokinetic (GENE, CGYRO, GX, or similar) codes

  • Julia and Python programming – our integrated modeling framework is written in Julia

  • Familiarity with the IMAS data model

  • Familiarity with AI-assisted development tools

  • A track record of published validation studies or successful experimental proposals

INTERVIEW PROCESS

  • Recruiter Interview (30-60 min)

  • Technical Screening (30 min)

  • Technical Panel (3x60 min)

At Proxima Fusion, our mission is bold: making limitless clean energy a reality. To get there, we need a high-performing, diverse team that brings different perspectives, challenges assumptions, and builds together with purpose. We know that diversity of thought and experience leads to better ideas, stronger execution, and a more resilient team. We don’t look at how you identify, what you look like, who you choose to worship or what ethnicity you are. We care about what you can bring to the table.

  • 🚀 High-growth startup experience: You’ve worked in a fast-growing environment where processes change quickly, ownership is high, and the answer isn't always already documented.

  • 🛠️ Builder mindset: You don't just execute a process — you notice where it isn't working and help improve it. You’re comfortable creating structure while doing the work at the same time.

  • 🤖 Automation mindset: You’re interested in using automation and AI to eliminate repetitive work and make high-volume processes more scalable.

Nice-to-haves

  • 🏢 Exposure to a mature renewals function: You’ve seen what strong renewal processes look like at a larger SaaS company and can bring some of those learnings into an earlier-stage environment.

Why join us?

At n8n, you won’t be stepping into a fully established renewal function - you’ll help create it.

Our Scaled Customer Success team is still relatively new, while the number of customers and renewals we manage is growing quickly. We’re particularly interested in using AI and automation to scale the function without simply adding more headcount, so if you enjoy finding smarter ways to eliminate repetitive work and improve processes, you’ll have plenty of room to experiment.

Sound like a challenge you’re excited to take on? Apply now and help us build the renewal motion that will support n8n’s next stage of growth.

Aufgaben

Du baust unser Business Development auf – als Head of, zunächst ohne Team, mit direktem Draht zur Geschäftsführung. Eines vorweg: Das ist kein klassischer Vertriebs- oder Sales-Job, sondern B2B-Beziehungsarbeit – Neukundengewinnung über Vertrauen statt über Kaltakquise.

  • Beziehungen zu Netzbetreibern: Du baust Beziehungen zu Telcos, Mobilfunk- und Festnetzbetreibern, MVNOs, ISPs und Carriern auf und pflegst sie langfristig – Key Account Management und Partnermanagement im besten Sinne
  • Chancen erkennen: Du beobachtest den Markt und erkennst Chancen, lange bevor daraus konkrete Projekte werden – und öffnest die Türen dafür
  • Strategie aufbauen: Du entwickelst unsere Business-Development-Strategie und die Prozesse dahinter von Grund auf
  • Gespräche anbahnen: Du führst Erstgespräche und begleitest Opportunities bis zur Übergabe an die Geschäftsführung

Qualifikation

Uns interessiert weniger Dein Lebenslauf – uns interessiert, wie Du mit Menschen kannst. Technisches Vorwissen brauchst Du nicht – unsere Themen sind hochtechnisch, aber die Details vermitteln wir. Neugier und schnelle Auffassungsgabe dagegen kann man nicht beibringen.

Und Du musst diese Rolle nicht schon jahrelang gemacht haben: Es gibt sie bei uns noch nicht, sie darf mit Dir wachsen. Was Du mitbringen musst, ist Lust darauf – und den Mut, auf Menschen zuzugehen, die Du noch nicht kennst.

  • Du liebst Menschen. Nicht als Floskel, sondern wirklich: Beziehungen aufzubauen und zu pflegen ist für Dich kein Job, sondern Dein Naturell
  • Netzwerken ist Deine Stärke: Du wartest auf keiner Veranstaltung darauf, angesprochen zu werden – und hast nach einem Abend mehr wertvolle Kontakte als andere in einer ganzen Messewoche
  • Kommunikation auf C-Level ist für Dich keine Kür, sondern Teil des Spiels: Du begegnest Vorständen, Geschäftsführern und Entscheidern bei Telcos, ISPs und Carriern selbstverständlich auf Augenhöhe – genauso wie bei Verbänden und auf Branchenevents
  • Du bist extrovertiert, ohne aufgesetzt zu wirken: offen, authentisch, vertrauenswürdig
  • Antrieb: Du bist top-motiviert und willst mit uns gemeinsam etwas Großes aufbauen – Dienst nach Vorschrift gibt es bei uns nicht, in keine Richtung
  • Sprachen: Du kommunizierst verhandlungssicher auf Deutsch und Englisch
  • Unternehmerisch: Du arbeitest eigenständig, denkst unternehmerisch und willst etwas aufbauen, nicht verwalten

Hilfreich, aber kein Muss: Erfahrung im Business Development, Key Account Management oder Partnermanagement – oder ein Hintergrund in Regulierung, Verbandsarbeit, Beratung oder im Behördenumfeld.

Ein echtes Plus: ein bestehendes Netzwerk zu Telcos, ISPs, MVNOs und Carriern – idealerweise international. Nice to have: Kontakte zu Ermittlungs- und Sicherheitsbehörden im internationalen Umfeld, denn auch die Behördenseite wird für uns ein wachsendes Feld.

Benefits

  • Internationale Events und Reisen: Du bist unterwegs, wo die Branche sich trifft
  • Hybrid: Büro im Belgischen Viertel in Köln plus Homeoffice – Deinen Kalender bestimmst Du weitgehend selbst
  • Team: Kleines, top-motiviertes Team mit kurzen Wegen, das gemeinsam etwas reißen will
  • Gesprächsstoff: Ein Arbeitsumfeld, von dem Du beim nächsten Abendessen erzählen kannst (zumindest das, was Du erzählen darfst)

Klingt nach Dir? Dann lass uns reden. Kein Anschreiben nötig – schick uns Deinen Lebenslauf und zwei, drei Sätze, warum diese Rolle Dich reizt. Oder noch besser: Erzähl uns von einem Kontakt, den Du geknüpft hast, obwohl es unmöglich schien. Wenn es grundsätzlich passt, lernen wir uns zuerst in einem vertraulichen Gespräch kennen.

jobs.title: Staff Frontend Engineer / Frontend Architect (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Introduction

Teaser

Two products, two backends, one frontend vision: build the AI-first frontend platform and design system that lets our engineers, product managers and designers ship UI at speed. A senior hands-on role with architect-level influence, no people management, and our CPTO as your executive sponsor.

Role at a glance

  • Level: Staff/Principal-level individual contributor – technical leadership, no direct reports
  • Reporting line: VP Engineering. Executive sponsor: our CPTO
  • Products: FactFinder NG (React on a Java backend) and Infinity (React on a .NET/F# backend)
  • Stack you'll shape: React, TypeScript, Web Components, design tokens, Storybook, AI coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, MCP-based tooling)
  • Team: Product & Technology organization of around 25 people, led by our CPTO, working in a product trio model with product and design
  • Location: Berlin; Munich, Pforzheim or Stockholm possible – hybrid with 2–3 office days per week; occasional travel (<10%) for offsites and design-system workshops
  • Start: as soon as possible

About FactFinder

FactFinder is one of the leading product discovery platforms for European eCommerce. For more than 20 years we've applied AI and machine learning to product search, navigation, personalization and recommendations. Our Product Discovery Experience (PDX) spans two products: FactFinder NG, an exact and highly configurable search, and Infinity, a self-learning, behavioral discovery engine. More than 2,000 customers generate over €160 billion in annual GMV on our platform.

We're around 90 people with a new management team, a clear growth plan and reknown investors behind us. Right now we're rebuilding our product and tech organization around an AI-first way of working and agentic commerce – and this role sits at the center of it.

Why this role exists

Our two products run two React frontends with very different technical roots. We need a vision, an architect, and an owner — someone who will unify them into a single, efficient system, build the shared design system on top, and enable product managers and designers to prototype and ship production-grade UI themselves with AI tooling. Incrementally, without a big-bang rewrite, and while both products keep shipping.


Your mission

What you'll do

  • Define and drive the target frontend architecture across both React products – one consistent, efficient React-based system, migrated step by step
  • Build and own our shared design system: tokens, component library and Web Components for embeddable shop UI, tightly aligned with Product Design
  • Create an AI-first prototyping and contribution framework – design system, AI coding tools, guardrails, automated review and CI – so product managers and designers can prototype and contribute production-grade UI
  • Stay hands-on: write a significant share of the critical code, set standards, and pair with and level up our frontend engineers
  • Work with a clear operating split: after architecture-focused first stints, spend around 80% of your time hands-on coding and 20% on architecture, design-system leadership and enablement
What success looks like
  • After 90 days: frontend audit of both products done, target architecture and migration roadmap agreed, design-system tokens and core components live, and the first prototype built and shipped by a product manager or designer on the new framework
  • After 12 months: both products run on the shared design system, the frontend rework shows measurable efficiency gains, and product and design prototype independently as a routine – frontend is no longer the bottleneck


Your profile

Must-have

  • Expert-level React and TypeScript, proven in complex production SaaS frontends
  • A real AI-first engineering practice: you use AI coding tools and agents daily and have built workflows or frameworks that others use – not just "I use Copilot"
  • Design-system architecture: you've built or led a design system (tokens, component library, Storybook or similar) that was adopted across multiple teams or products
  • Web Components (Custom Elements, Shadow DOM, embedding in third-party environments) plus a frontend architecture track record: you've modernized or migrated a frontend stack at least once, ideally several times
  • 6+ years in frontend or software engineering, including 3+ years at Staff, Lead or Architect level – setting technical direction across teams, not just within your own
  • Hands-on today: you write production code yourself – this is not a concept-only architect position
  • Business-fluent English (C1); no formal degree required, your track record counts
Nice-to-have
  • Technical leadership without line management: you've led a SaaS frontend team through a major technology change
  • Meta-frameworks such as Next.js and/or Astro – and a clear view on when to use which
  • Design-to-code and prototyping tooling: Figma workflows, design-token pipelines, AI UI generation (v0, Claude Code, Cursor, MCP-based tooling)
  • eCommerce, search or product discovery frontends (search UIs, embeddable shop widgets)
  • React on non-JavaScript backends (Java/Spring, .NET); Fable/Feliz or Ant Design
  • Good German language skills


Bonus Points

Who thrives here

  • Builders who ship code themselves and lead by example
  • Pragmatic simplifiers: incremental migration over big-bang rewrites, no over-engineering
  • Change agents with strong opinions, weakly held – able to transform an organization without burning it out
  • Enablers who enjoy making product managers and designers productive and treat them as peers
Probably not for you if you'd rather produce architecture concepts than running code, want to go deep on one product and leave the cross-product system to others, or are looking for a people-management role.


THE JOY OF WORKING WITH US

What we offer

  • Real ownership with executive backing: you shape the frontend of two products end to end. You report to our VP Engineering; our CPTO is the executive sponsor of this role – both agree the target architecture and migration roadmap with you, and the CPTO reviews your 90-day goals and holds your final interview. A company-level priority, not a side project
  • AI-first as a leadership priority, with the tooling budget to match: Claude Code, Cursor or whatever makes you fastest
  • Impact without switching to management: a Staff/Principal IC track on our career ladder toward Principal/Distinguished – with the option to move into engineering management later if you want to
  • A product trio culture: engineering, product and design as co-owners, outcomes over outputs
  • Competitive compensation that reflects the Staff level of this role
  • Training and conference budget, 30 days of vacation, modern equipment, mobility offers and a company pension plan
  • Hybrid work with 2–3 office days per week in Berlin, Munich, Pforzheim or Stockholm

How we hire

Remote, with feedback within 48 hours after every step:

1. 30-minute intro call with our Recruiter Mirko
2. 60-minute technical interview with our VP Engineering (your future manager) and an engineering lead: one frontend modernization you led, your design-system story, and how you use AI day to day
3. Case study: a hands-on part (AI tools explicitly welcome – walk us through how you used them) and a 45-minute architecture session
4. Team panel and a 45-minute conversation with our CPTO – optionally on site

FAQ

Is this a people-management role? No. It's a senior individual-contributor role: you lead through architecture, standards and enablement, without direct reports.

Who will I report to? Our VP Engineering. The role is sponsored by our CPTO: the frontend platform is one of the CPTO's top priorities, you agree the target architecture and migration roadmap together, and the CPTO holds your final interview.

Which tech stack will I work with? React and TypeScript on both products. FactFinder NG runs on a Java backend, Infinity on .NET/F# (with Fable/Feliz on the frontend). Backend, F# and our search domain are things you can learn here – React expertise, Web Components, design-system architecture and AI-first practice are what you bring from day one.

Is "AI-first" real here, or a buzzword? It's driven by our CPTO and part of the career ladder for every engineer. Your mandate is to take it from individual productivity to organization-wide practice.

Two legacy frontends on Java and .NET – isn't that painful? That's exactly the mandate: unify them, and how is your call. Incremental, not big-bang.

Can I work fully remote? No – the role is hybrid with 2–3 office days per week at one of our offices.

Why eCommerce search? Because agentic commerce is where AI meets real purchase decisions – on our platform that's 2,000+ shops and €160+ billion in GMV a year.

Apply

Send us your CV or LinkedIn profile plus links to work you're proud of (GitHub, a design system, a talk, a blog post) – and tell us in three sentences how you use AI in your daily engineering work. No cover letter needed.

Your contact: Mirko Duus

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Wealth & AI (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
What we do

At getquin, we're on a mission to empower everyone to build wealth.

Founded in 2020, we started with a simple idea: help people see their entire financial life in one place, so they can make more informed decisions.

Today, getquin has grown into one of the largest wealth platforms globally, already helping over half a million users manage and grow their wealth. Our platform combines analytics, tools and community to make wealth-building accessible for everyone, not just the experts.

After launching in Germany, we've started expanding across Europe, with a focus on growing our user base, building valuable new features and helping even more people take control of their financial future.

If you're excited to help shape the future of personal wealth management, join us. We're just getting started.


What you'll be doing

You've built products for investors. You know what a TER actually does to a long-run return, why a user with four brokers has no visbility what they really own, and how differently people behave when the number on screen is their pension rather than their pocket money.

You've probably also hit the ceiling of what a chart can tell someone. Better tables, more filters, another allocation donut. The data was always there; the answer never quite arrived.

We have something nobody else has: a complete, cross-institution picture of a person's wealth. Investments, cash, liabilities and insurance contracts, in one place, for over half a million users. Your work is turning that into features and insights people understand and act on, and the interesting tools for doing that now include AI.

We're looking for an experienced Senior Product Manager to own that area. You'll work directly with the founders and the product team, alongside engineering and our financial advisory teams. This is a senior individual contributor role with no direct reports, and you'll mentor less experienced product managers on the team.

Own the wealth product area end to end

  • Set the product strategy and roadmap across the picture we give people of their wealth and how we help them optimize it
  • Decide what we build on aggregated portfolio data that nobody with a single-broker view could build at all
  • Own our efforts to stay on the forefront of digital wealth management services and play your part in disrupting a still very offline industry
  • Work the unglamorous, high-leverage problems too: data quality, coverage gaps, missing cost basis, duplicate holdings across connections, ETFs held through more than one broker. A portfolio insight is only as trustworthy as the numbers under it

Turn the data into something users act on

  • Define the insights we surface about someone's portfolio, cash position and risk, and why each one earns a place on their screen
  • Own our conversational AI assistant and our AI-driven insights: what they say, what they refuse to say, and how a user knows which is which
  • Set the quality bar for anything we tell a user about their money: accuracy targets, human review, guardrails, rollback. Decide when something is good enough to ship and hold that line when the pressure is to ship anyway

Own the numbers

  • Define the metrics for your area: activation, engagement, the insight-to-action funnel, and contribution to subscription conversion and retention
  • Run the experiments, including proper A/B testing, read them, and report what didn't work alongside what did
  • Live in your own product analytics and write your own queries and reporting, rather than wait for someone to give that to you


What we are looking for

You might be a fit if:

  • You've built wealth management, investing or portfolio products. You know the domain properly: instruments, ETFs, costs, allocation, risk, tax drag, and how retail investors actually behave rather than how they should. This is the requirement we're least flexible on
  • You've owned a product area end to end against a number you defined yourself, with real experimentation behind it
  • You've shipped at least one AI or LLM-based feature to production for real users, and you owned its output quality. 
  • You've shipped inside a legal or compliance constraint, and you can reason about where an insight becomes advice. 
  • Your product discovery produces evidence, not opinion. You can show us a real research artefact and a decision that changed because of it
  • You're fluent in English; German is a plus
  • You can work from our Berlin office, and you already have the right to work in Germany

That usually adds up to around five or more years in product, but we care about the evidence, not the year count. If you came to product from engineering, data science, research, design, financial services, or from a Product Owner role, that counts. 

Strong plus if you have:

  • PSD2, open banking or account aggregation experience
  • Insurance or brokerage product exposure, which matters as we move into advisory
  • Recommendation systems or personalisation at scale
  • Subscription and paywall experimentation
  • Experience mentoring or coaching other product managers
  • Your own portfolio, and opinions about it

If you meet most of this and not all of it, apply. We'd rather read your application than guess.

Work authorisation

This role requires an existing right to work in Germany. We're not able to sponsor visas or support relocation for this position, so we can only consider candidates who already hold German or EU work authorisation, or who can obtain it independently. We'd rather tell you now than after four conversations.

What the first six months look like

  • Month 1: you know the data model, the aggregation layer and its technology behind it. What our analytics do and don't cover, and understand how AI is already being used and where it. You've written down the three things you think are most wrong with the product today
  • Months 2 to 3: a written, agreed area strategy with a prioritised roadmap, a primary metric with a baseline, and, clear metrics that you will be monitoring and optimizing along the way
  • Months 3 to 4: the first thing you scoped is live to a user segment, with a read on the primary metric, and with quality measurement behind it if it involves generated output
  • Months 5 to 6: two or three shipped iterations with measured results, including the ones that didn't work, a quality bar the team applies without you in the room, and at least one junior product manager who's visibly better at their job because of you

You won't be measured on shipping volume. You'll be measured on whether your area got measurably more useful and more trustworthy.


Why join getquin?

Why join getquin?

We're a fast-growing B2C fintech, and here, your work has real impact. From day one, you'll take ownership of your domain, ship features end-to-end, and help shape the direction of a product used across Europe. We value initiative, ownership and creativity, not layers of process.

Three things that are specifically true of this role:

  • Wealth management is ripe for disruption. Following digitalisation waves of banking and brokerage services, we are leading those efforts across the next big topic for private individuals: better understand  and optimize your wealth
  • The data asset is genuinely rare. Aggregated cross-institution wealth for half a million people, with over +€25bn in connected assets. Trade Republic sees its own platform. N26 sees the current account. Nobody else in Europe sees the whole picture, which means there are product questions you can only answer here
  • You'll own the area, not a slice of it. At our size the decisions are yours

Ready to build something meaningful? Then join us at the forefront of making wealth building accessible to everyone.

How we hire

Five conversations, typically three to four weeks from first call to decision. We tell you where you stand after every step, and we respond within seven days at every stage.

  1. Recruiter screen, 30 min, video. Role, scope, the salary band, hybrid expectation, notice period, work authorisation. No trick questions
  2. Hiring manager, 60 min, video. Your product area ownership, the outcome you drove, and your depth in the wealth domain. This is the first real fit conversation, in both directions
  3. Product case, take home. We give you a real getquin problem on aggregated wealth data and work through it together. We know you already have a job, hence we do not impose an in-person case during working hours
  4. Cross-functional panel, 2 x 30 min, in our Berlin office. Cover in more depth your case study and deep dive further in your understanding of product metrics and approach to product development. Usually in person in our office.
  5. Close conversation, 30 min. Team fit, how you like to work, and whatever is still open, including your questions for a founder

Along the last part we will be making reference checks, but only with former employers. Once we have this, we will make you a formal offer. 

The whole loop runs in English. Tell us if you need any adjustment to the process, whether timing, format or accessibility, and we'll make it. You don't need to explain why.

jobs.title: Full Stack Product Developer (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Aufgaben 

Du willst Technologie gestalten, die direkt etwas bewegt? 

Bei Table.Briefings entwickeln wir digitale Produkte für ein wachsendes Medienunternehmen. Unsere Software hilft dabei, Prozesse effizienter zu machen, neue Geschäftsmodelle zu ermöglichen und unseren Redaktionen den Rücken freizuhalten – damit sie sich auf das konzentrieren können, was sie am besten können: hochwertigen Journalismus!
Als dritter interner Entwickler bzw. dritte interne Entwicklerin übernimmst du eine zentrale Rolle in unserem Tech-Team. Du arbeitest an der gesamten Entwicklungskette: von der ersten Idee über Konzeption und Umsetzung bis zu Deployment, Betrieb und Weiterentwicklung.
Dabei geht es nicht nur darum, Features zu programmieren. Du hilfst uns, die richtigen Probleme zu erkennen, Anforderungen zu schärfen und Lösungen zu entwickeln, die für unser Business, unsere Nutzerinnen und Nutzer und unsere Redaktionen wirklich einen Unterschied machen. 


Deine Aufgaben 

  • Du konzipierst, entwickelst und betreust unsere Webanwendungen, APIs und Apps.
  • Du arbeitest an unseren Statamic-basierten Plattformen und entwickelst unser CMS weiter.
  • Du entwickelst neue Funktionen mit unserem bestehenden Tech-Stack und verbesserst bestehende Lösungen kontinuierlich.
  • Du beschäftigst dich mit dem Einsatz und der Optimierung von Large Language Models und Coding Agents– zur Automatisierung interner Prozesse und für neue Produktfeatures.
  • Du entwickelst und integrierst RESTful APIs, zum Beispiel zur Anbindung von Systemen wie ActiveCampaign.
  • Du wirkst bei der Konfiguration, Wartung und Absicherung unserer Linux-Server und Deployment-Prozesse mit.
  • Du übersetzt Anforderungen aus unterschiedlichen Bereichen in klare technische Lösungen.
  • Du bringst Struktur in komplexe oder noch nicht vollständig definierte Aufgaben und sorgst dafür, dass aus Ideen umsetzbare Produkte werden.
  • Du arbeitest eng mit Stakeholdern, Produktverantwortlichen, Redaktion und Geschäftsführung zusammen.

Unser Tech-Stack - Wir arbeiten unter anderem mit: 

  • PHP und Laravel
  • Statamic
  • PostgreSQL
  • Livewire
  • HTML, CSS und JavaScript
  • RESTful APIs
  • Linux-Servern und modernen Deployment-Prozessen
  • Large Language Models und Coding Agents
Du musst unseren Tech-Stack nicht bereits vollständig beherrschen – wichtiger sind uns dein technisches Verständnis, deine Kommunikationsstärke und deine Fähigkeit, komplexe Anforderungen schnell in gute Lösungen zu übersetzen. Du solltest aber Lust haben, mit unseren Technologien zu arbeiten und dich schnell in neue Systeme und Themen einzuarbeiten. 
Wir suchen keine Person, die jedes Tool schon einmal eingesetzt hat, sondern jemanden, der gute technische Entscheidungen trifft, Zusammenhänge versteht und Verantwortung übernimmt.


Qualifikation

  • Du hast fundierte Erfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung und beherrschst mindestens eine relevante Programmiersprache sicher.
  • Du hast idealerweise Erfahrung mit Webanwendungen, APIs und Datenbanken.
  • Du interessierst dich für unseren Tech-Stack und hast Lust, dich inLaravel,Statamic, PostgreSQL und Livewire einzuarbeiten oder darin weiterzuentwickeln.
  • Du verstehst, wie man LLMs und CodingAgentssinnvoll und verantwortungsvoll in der Softwareentwicklung einsetzt – oder möchtest es lernen.
  • Du kennst dich mit Linux-Servern,Deploymentund grundlegenden Fragen der IT-Sicherheit aus oder bist bereit, dich in diese Themen einzuarbeiten.
  • Du kannst komplexe Probleme schnell erfassen, priorisieren und in konkrete nächste Schritte übersetzen.
  • Du kommunizierst klar und gerne – auch mit Menschen, die nicht technisch arbeiten.
  • Du kannst unterschiedliche Anforderungen und Perspektiven zusammenbringen und sicher mit Stakeholdern umgehen.
  • Du arbeitest selbstständig, zuverlässig und lösungsorientiert.
  • Du behältst auch dann den Überblick, wenn Anforderungen sich verändern, Informationen zunächst unvollständig sind oder mehrere Themen gleichzeitig auf dem Tisch liegen.
  • Du hast Freude daran, in solchen Situationen Ruhe, Struktur und Verbindlichkeit zu schaffen.
  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse sind für die Kommunikation im Team und mit unseren Stakeholdern unerlässlich.

Was uns wichtig ist

Wir entwickeln nicht zum Selbstzweck. Unser Ziel ist Software, die unmittelbar Wirkung entfaltet: für unser Geschäft, für die Vervielfachung unserer Lizenzen und für unsere Redaktionen, die täglich anspruchsvolle Inhalte produzieren.
Dafür suchen wir eine Persönlichkeit, die Verantwortung übernimmt, Fragen stellt und sich aktiv einbringt. Du solltest dich in einem meinungsstarken, dynamischen Umfeld wohlfühlen, unterschiedliche Perspektiven aushalten und deine eigenen Ideen überzeugend vertreten können. Gleichzeitig ist uns wichtig, dass du pragmatisch bleibst und gemeinsam mit anderen zu guten Lösungen kommst.


Benefits

Wir bieten dir: 

  • Eine Schlüsselposition in einem innovativen und wachstumsstarken Medienunternehmen
  • Die Möglichkeit,unseren Tech-Stackaktiv mitzugestalten und weiterzuentwickeln
  • Viel Eigenverantwortung und kurze Entscheidungswege
  • Einen vielseitigen Job mit direktem Einfluss auf unser Business und unsere Produkte
  • Eine unbefristete Festanstellung in Teilzeit oder Vollzeit
  • 28 Tage Urlaub
  • Flexibilität bei Arbeitszeit und Arbeitsort > Drei Tage pro Woche in unserem Büro in Berlin-Mitte, zwei Tage im MobileOffice
  • Persönliche und fachliche Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten in einer echten Wachstumskultur
  • Eine offene, freundliche Atmosphäre mit Partnerinnen, Partnern und Kolleginnen und Kollegen aus der ganzen Welt


Deine Bewerbung 

Wir freuen uns auf deinen Lebenslauf und ein kurzes, persönliches Motivationsschreiben mit maximal 1.000 Zeichen: Warum möchtest du als Full Stack Product Developer (m/w/d) bei Table.Briefings arbeiten? 

Uns interessiert besonders, welche Probleme du gerne löst, wie du mit unterschiedlichen Anforderungen umgehst und was dich daran reizt, Technologie mit konkretem unternehmerischem und redaktionellem Nutzen zu entwickeln.

Bei 7 Elements machen wir Elektrolyte ohne Zucker — ohne Bullshit und Füllstoffe, über unseren eigenen Shop verkauft, entwickelt von unserer Gründerin, einer Ärztin. Übernimm unser TikTok und Instagram, arbeite mit Creatorn, dreh eigene Videos und probier aus, was funktioniert. Werde Teil eines kleinen Hamburger Teams mit kurzen Wegen, in dem deine Ideen nicht untergehen, sondern maßgeblich mitgestalten.

  • Instagram: Du pflegst Feed und Stories und hältst die Bildsprache konsistent.
  • Influencer und UGC: Du suchst passende Creator, sprichst sie an, betreust die Zusammenarbeit und sorgst dafür, dass am Ende Content herauskommt, den wir auch nutzen können.
  • Content-Produktion: Du machst eigene Fotos und Videos — Produkt, Lifestyle, Behind the Scenes.
  • KI-Tools: Wir arbeiten intern mit KI für Bild, Text und Automatisierung. Du nutzt diese Tools aktiv und baust unsere Workflows mit aus.
  • Richtung mitbestimmen: Du bringst eigene Formate und Kanäle ein, testest sie und sagst uns ehrlich, was funktioniert und was nicht.

Qualifikation

  • Du bist offen und kommunikativ und hast Lust, als rechte Hand der CEO an spannenden Projekten zu arbeiten.
  • Du begeisterst dich für Vertrieb und Marketing, KI und Prozessoptimierung und bist motiviert, deine Fähigkeiten weiter auszubauen.
  • Du bist sicher im Umgang mit sozialen Netzwerken.
  • Du hast sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse und ausreichende Englischkenntnisse.
  • Du hast idealerweise drei bis sechs Monate Zeit, die du mit uns verbringen möchtest.

Benefits

  • 50% Remote möglich
  • Start-Up Mentalität hautnah von einem in Hamburger gegründeten Start-Up mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen
  • Regelmäßiges Feedback, viel Gestaltungsspielraum und die Chance eigene Ideen umzusetzen bieten dir die Möglichkeit wertvolle Erfahrungen fürs Berufsleben zu sammeln
  • Energetisches Arbeitsumfeld! Du hast eine Idee? Dann setzen wir sie gemeinsam um!

  • Seite an Seite mit einer Ärztin. Du arbeitest direkt mit der Gründerin zusammen, die das Produkt selbst entwickelt hat. Du lernst, worüber du schreibst — und wie man über Gesundheitsthemen kommuniziert, ohne Unsinn zu behaupten. Diese Sicherheit haben die wenigsten Marketing-Leute in dieser Branche.

jobs.title: Project Security Officer
jobs.description:
Here at The Exploration Company, we are building spacecrafts for humanity.

Join us as a Project Security Officer, where you’ll be the primary security interface for the Nyx project, connecting Mission Operations with central security functions, engineering teams, suppliers, and external partners. You’ll translate requirements into practical, verifiable controls across our mission systems, working hands-on with engineers, technicians, and operators from concept through operations. Applications at all seniority levels are considered.

 

Key Responsibilities

  • Act as the single point of contact for security-related topics on the Nyx project.

  • Translate company policies, customer requirements, regulations, and threat intelligence into project-specific security requirements, architectures, procedures, and verification criteria.

  • Maintain the integrated project security risk picture across cyber, physical, personnel, supply-chain, export-control, and security-architecture domains.

  • Flow security requirements into systems, subsystems, suppliers, and operations, and verify their implementation with objective evidence.

  • Work hands-on with engineers and the security team to implement secure configurations, access controls, segmentation, monitoring, vulnerability remediation, encryption, and other cybersecurity controls.

  • Support threat modelling, risk assessments, security-by-design, system reviews, supplier assessments, security readiness, and assurance activities throughout the project lifecycle.

What we would love to see from you:

The ideal candidate will have:

  • Bachelor’s degree in cybersecurity, computer science, engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

  • 3+ years of relevant experience in cybersecurity engineering, systems security, infrastructure security, operational technology, embedded security, project security, or a related hands-on field.

  • Experience working across multiple technical domains, such as networks, operating systems, applications, communications, embedded systems, hardware, or data centers.

  • Experience translating security requirements, policies, regulations, or customer expectations into system designs, technical controls, configurations, tests, procedures, and objective evidence.

  • Experience in security risk management, including risk-based vulnerability prioritization, threat and risk analysis, security testing, incident response, supplier and supply-chain security, and secure system integration.

  • Practical experience configuring, hardening, troubleshooting, or monitoring real systems—not only reviewing designs or producing documentation.

  • Ability to integrate cyber, physical, personnel, supply-chain, export-control, and security-architecture considerations into a coherent project-security approach.

  • Strong communication, organization, project-management, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to build trust across Corporate IT, engineering, suppliers, central security functions, and Mission Operations.

 

Bonus qualifications:

  • Experience working with operators in control rooms, mission-control environments, NOCs, SOCs, launch campaigns, test operations, or other time-critical operational settings.

  • Experience securing spacecraft, launch systems, ground stations, mission-control centers, satellite communications, telemetry systems, or other complex control systems.

  • Experience integrating security into system design, supplier agreements, procurement, verification, acceptance, and operational readiness.

  • Familiarity with relevant cybersecurity, space, export-control, or customer frameworks, including NIST CSF, ISO 27001, IEC 62443, ECSS, or applicable national requirements.

  • Relevant certifications or demonstrated experience with security tooling, automation, vulnerability assessment, monitoring, detection, or incident response.

Why you should join us!

What makes us special here at The Exploration Company and why we think you will enjoy working here is:  

  • We’re Agile - we make decisions fast whilst keeping our goals and systems in mind 

  • We’re Open and Collaborative - we are transparent about risks and obstacles, so that we can cooperate to overcome them  

  • We have a lot of Fun - we refuel our energy knowing we are democratising space. It’s a wonderful and rare opportunity, are YOU up for the challenge?  

We'd love to hear from you if you wish to be a part of our journey. Please submit your CV now for immediate consideration and we will be in touch shortly. 
 
The Exploration Company is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status or disability status. Relocation assistance is provided for those willing to relocate including visa sponsorship where applicable.  


All offers are contingent upon the successful completion of a background check, which will be subject to the country, role, and project you applied for. jobs.title: CTO / Technical Co-Founder (f/m/d) role at startup METAKI
jobs.description:
**METAKI
**Dresden, Germany (TU Dresden) | On-site / Hybrid | Co-Founder / Equity | Deep Tech / AI for Engineering

**About Metaki
**Metaki is building a 'Large Engineering Model' (LEM): a graph-neural-network surrogate trained on large-scale finite element simulation (FEA) data that predicts, near-instantly, how complex 3D parts respond to different materials, loads and boundary conditions — replacing slow FEA runs. The initial focus is solid and structural mechanics, with the long-term ambition of a general foundation model for engineering physics.

**The opportunity
**Founded by Samir El Masri (Founder, ongoing PhD in FEM, 3 years of industry experience in FEM & AI/ML for engineering), Metaki already has a working FEM → data → NN pipeline, is building out a large 3D training dataset, and is running training alongside early industry discussions. What's missing is a technical co-founder to help scale the modeling and engineering work while Samir also drives funding applications and industrial pilot partnerships.

Tasks

**What you will own
**

**Model & platform development
**- Co-own the neural-network surrogate modeling pipeline (FEM data → GNN training → fast inference), extending it from solid/structural mechanics towards a general engineering-physics foundation model.
- Scale the large 3D simulation dataset and physics-informed training infrastructure currently in development.

**Technical leadership
**- Take technical/CTO ownership alongside Samir El Masri (Founder), covering architecture, ML engineering and data pipeline decisions.
- Help turn early industry discussions into validated industrial pilots by making the model production-ready.

**Fundraising support
**- Support funding applications and strategic introductions with a credible technical narrative and roadmap.

Requirements

**What you bring
**

**Core experience
**- Strong machine learning background, ideally with graph neural networks, surrogate modeling, or physics-informed ML.
- Comfort working with finite element simulation data and engineering/physics domain concepts (solid or structural mechanics a plus).

**Especially valuable
**- Software/ML engineering experience taking a research pipeline to a scalable, production-ready product.
- Interest in building toward a general foundation model for engineering physics.
- Experience with industrial pilot partnerships or applied research collaborations.

Benefits

**Why join Metaki
**- A working FEM → data → NN pipeline already built, not just an idea — real technical traction to build on.
- Early industry discussions already underway, with funding applications and pilot partnerships actively being pursued.
- Ground-floor technical co-founder equity in a company aiming to become a foundational-model platform for engineering physics.

Metaki welcomes co-founder candidates regardless of gender, age, ethnic origin, religion or belief, disability, sexual identity, or any other characteristic. This is a search for the right partner to build the company with, not a conventional hire.
