Nous recherchons un ingénieur des procédés capable d’apporter l’expérience, l’expertise et le dynamisme nécessaires pour faire progresser nos procédés, qu’ils soient nouveaux ou déjà établis, et renforcer notre position de leader mondial dans le domaine du retraitement des résidus à haute valeur ajoutée.

Après une période d’intégration qui vous permettra de bien comprendre nos process, alliant procédés chimiques, mécaniques et automatismes, vous serez chargé de développer, contrôler, surveiller et améliorer en permanence les procédés de fabrication. Vous serez amené à intervenir sur l’ensemble des process de fabrication mais votre mission sera particulièrement orientée vers notre process de nettoyage des alliages.


Rattaché à notre Directeur Process Groupe, basé au Royaume Unis, et en étroite collaboration avec les équipes d’ingénierie, d’exploitation, de maintenance, de qualité et commerciales, vous traduirez les exigences des clients et de l’entreprise en procédés de fabrication robustes et reproductibles. Vous rédigez ainsi les process et les standards notamment pour les process spécifiques du site d’Eyrein.

Vous êtes en contact avec nos fournisseurs pour assurer les évolutions ou développement de nos process et en supervisez la mise en œuvre. Vous rédigez les cahiers des charges et les évolutions de process nécessaires pour atteindre les objectifs de l’Entreprise.

Au-delà d’une formation de niveau Bac +5, vous disposez avant tout d’une expérience réussie sur un poste similaire au sein d’une industrie d’au moins 3 à 5 ans.

Femme ou homme de terrain, vous êtes reconnu pour votre curiosité, votre capacité à comprendre des process complexes. Vous savez identifier les opportunités et proposer des actions correctives tout en accompagnant le développement de l’activité. Votre sens aigu de l’organisation et votre excellent relationnel, vous permettent d’interagir avec l’ensemble des services techniques de l’entreprise en France comme à l’étranger.

La maitrise de l’anglais tant à l’oral qu’à l’écrit est un prérequis pour mener à bien cette mission. Vous faites preuve d’une bonne capacité d’analyse et d’écoute ainsi que d’un bon esprit d’équipe.

Enfin, un fort sens de l’éthique, un esprit d’initiative et une orientation vers les résultats sont déterminants pour la réussite dans ce poste.

 

IMET ALLOYS est une société industrielle à forte valeur ajoutée, filiale d’un groupe international, spécialisée dans la valorisation et la sécurisation des métaux critiques (titane, superalliages) indispensables aux industries de pointe.

Basée à Eyrein, en France, l’entreprise, certifiée ISO 9001 et ISO 14001 est au cœur des enjeux européens de souveraineté industrielle, d’économie circulaire et de décarbonation.

En forte phase de développement, IMET ALLOYS conduit un ambitieux programme d’investissements industriels et structure ses opérations pour accompagner une croissance durable sur des marchés exigeants (aéronautique, médical, énergie).

jobs.title: Full time paid Internship DSU/ Stage DSU Paris
jobs.description:
Introduction

The selected person will join the Technopolis Group Data Science Unit (DSU), whose members work across different country offices. Our growing team brings together diverse academic backgrounds and a shared passion for developing data science applications to improve policymaking.
The DSU contributes to policy consulting projects and conducts R&D to develop and test new applications, sometimes in collaboration with internal and external partners. Its work includes record linkage, classification, natural language processing, web scraping, generative AI and dynamic visualisations.
As an intern, you will work alongside experienced data scientists and policy consultants, applying and developing your technical skills to address real-world policy questions.


About this job

The role of the intern in data science for public policy will be to support the data science components of policy evaluations, sectoral studies and strategic consultancy projects. Our clients include French regional councils, the French Development Agency (AFD), ADEME, the European Commission and multilateral development banks.
You will be part of the DSU and collaborate with colleagues across policy areas, including science, technology and innovation, economic development, the green transition, international cooperation and health. You may also contribute to internal R&D and business development activities, particularly the preparation of data science approaches for project proposals.
No previous professional experience is required. Relevant coursework, academic research and personal coding projects will be considered.
We are looking to recruit a full-time intern for at least 6 months starting in Automn 2026. Internship should be sponsored by the intern’s university (stage conventionné).


Your profile

We are looking for a curious and motivated individual who enjoys working with data and wants to understand how data science can inform public policy.
Suitable candidates should have:

  • Master’s-level studies in data science, computer science, statistics, economics, engineering or another relevant discipline with a strong quantitative component, and be eligible for a university-sponsored internship.
  • Practical programming skills in Python, demonstrated through coursework, research or personal projects, and the ability to write and understand their own analytical code.
  • Good foundations in statistics and quantitative analysis, together with an interest in economics and public policy and in interpreting analytical results in their policy context.
  • Basic familiarity with machine learning or natural language processing, and an interest in using generative AI and large language models programmatically through APIs for data processing, text analysis and knowledge extraction.
  • A careful and structured approach to working with data, including attention to data quality, validation, documentation and reproducibility.
  • An interest in public policy and in using data science to support evidence-based policymaking, particularly in areas such as science, technology and innovation, economic development, the green transition or health policy.
  • Fluency in French and English, good communication skills and an ability to work collaboratively in an international and multicultural environment. A third language would be an asset.


Your responsibilities

Working under the guidance of experienced colleagues, you will:

  • Support the design and implementation of data science analyses to answer policy questions, writing code in Python.
  • Collect, clean, link and validate data from multiple sources, including open datasets, databases and web-based sources.
  • Help develop and test analytical workflows, potentially involving machine learning, NLP and LLM APIs for classification, text analysis and knowledge extraction.
  • Contribute to indicators, scoreboards and visualisations, including dashboards where relevant, to make findings accessible to different audiences.
  • Interpret and communicate results, helping prepare reports, methodological documentation and presentations for clients.
  • Contribute to the DSU’s R&D and proposal preparation, for example by exploring new datasets, testing methods or developing small prototypes.


Our offer

We offer a paid internship in Paris, with hands-on experience at the intersection of data science and public policy. You will work with an international, multidisciplinary team, receive guidance from experienced colleagues and contribute to both client projects and the development of new analytical applications.
Many of our interns become full-time staff at Technopolis or go on to pursue opportunities in the public and private sectors.

jobs.description:
Camunda is the enterprise platform for agentic orchestration, enabling organizations to coordinate AI agents, people, and systems across complex, end-to-end business processes. Fully remote and global, we are in the middle of something bigger: transforming into an AI-first organisation, built on our own platform. We use Agentic AI to automate, orchestrate intelligent processes, and elevate human contribution across every team.

Named GP Bullhound’s Top 100 Next Unicorn list, 2025 Great Place to Work certified. Visionary in 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Business Orchestration and Automation Technologies. ranked 3rd in Flexa's 2026 Most Flexible Companies, We’re growing fast and looking for top talent to join our team. If you want meaningful work, visible impact and put something genuinely rare on your CV, keep reading.

About the Role:

As a Senior Software Engineer, Backend on Camunda’s Distributed Systems team, you’ll help build and evolve the durable, highly available, horizontally scalable streaming platform that underpins Camunda 8’s Orchestration Cluster and powers mission‑critical processes for customers around the world.

As part of the Distributed Systems team, you will work on technically challenging and rewarding projects, such as expanding on our multi-Raft implementation, our SWIM-based cluster membership algorithm, or high performance network and disk I/O pipelines.

At Camunda, we approach engineering in a holistic manner. As such, you will form strong partnerships with product management, design, QA, and sales, and work with your peers to not only deliver but directly influence the evolution of our platform to meet our customer’s needs.

Curious about the kind of challenges you'll work on at Camunda? Watch this quick 30-minute talk from our engineers to learn more about the new Camunda Exporter and how we’re solving complex problems at scale

What You Will Do:

  • Design, build, and maintain backend services for the distributed streaming platform that powers the foundation for Camunda 8’s orchestration capabilities, ensuring durability, high availability, and horizontal scalability.

  • Lead medium‑to‑large engineering initiatives (3+ months) end‑to‑end: partner with Product to translate business problems into technical requirements, write solution designs, draft and maintain project plans, and drive timely, high‑quality delivery.

  • Help mature our disaster recovery and resilience story, including implementing and evolving an online backup/restore API and contributing to improved multi‑region and multi‑tenant capabilities for our cloud offering.

  • Design and implement developer and operator tooling that makes it easier to understand, troubleshoot, and safely operate a complex distributed system in production environments.

  • Improve engineering effectiveness by collaborating with DevOps and other Core Application teams on CI, testing, and local development workflows to reduce PR time‑to‑merge and the overhead of working on multiple features in parallel.

  • Participate in L3 support and on‑call rotations, partnering closely with Support and SRE to investigate and resolve complex, performance‑sensitive production issues, and feeding what you learn back into our product and platform.

What You Will Bring to the Role:

Must Haves:

  • 7+ years of professional experience as a software engineer, with a strong focus on backend systems and/or distributed systems.

  • Proven experience leading medium‑to‑large engineering initiatives (roughly 3+ months), breaking down ambiguous problems, writing clear solution designs and project plans, coordinating with multiple teams, and driving predictable delivery.

  • Hands‑on experience building and maintaining highly concurrent, data‑intensive software, with a deep understanding of low‑level network and disk I/O (for example, throughput, latency, backpressure, batching, and failure modes).

  • Demonstrated ability to work autonomously and navigate ambiguity – you are comfortable taking on problems you haven’t solved before, breaking them down into concrete steps, and driving them to completion with minimal supervision.

  • Strong communication and collaboration skills in a remote‑first environment: you tailor explanations to your audience, translate business requirements into actionable technical work with Product, and help teams reach clear, decisive outcomes with minimal churn.

Nice to Haves:

  • Experience building workflow automation or process orchestration software.

  • Experience with distributed systems algorithms or protocols such as Raft, Paxos, SWIM, and/or CRDTs.

  • Strong familiarity with the observability pillars (logging, metrics, tracing) and how to integrate observability into the development and incident lifecycle, ideally including experience with L3 support and on‑call.

  • Deep knowledge of the Java Virtual Machine, especially its memory model and performance characteristics in highly concurrent, data‑intensive workloads.

jobs.description:
Localisation

Vous êtes passionné(e) par le développement des énergies renouvelables et vous connaissez bien le tissu économique et territorial de l’Est de la France ? Rejoignez Novar et devenez un acteur clé de la transition énergétique !

En tant que Développeur Nouveaux Projets, vous serez en première ligne pour identifier et sécuriser de nouveaux sites solaires et/ou de stockage en régions AURA et Bourgogne, tout en construisant des relations solides avec les acteurs locaux (collectivités, propriétaires fonciers, entreprises, partenaires). Grâce à votre sens du terrain et votre capacité à fédérer, vous participerez activement au développement de projets qui font sens pour le territoire et ses habitants.


Vos missions

·         Assurer une veille active des opportunités de marché (appels à projets, appels d’offres) sur votre territoire.

·         Construire et maintenir un réseau local solide, incluant partenaires, collectivités et apporteurs d’affaires.

·         Identifier de nouveaux sites à potentiel grâce à votre réseau, aux outils cartographiques et à vos actions de terrain.

·         Réaliser l’analyse technico-économique des sites, en intégrant contraintes et risques.

·         Approcher les propriétaires fonciers, agriculteurs, collectivités et clients C&I afin de présenter Novar et ses solutions.

·         Préparer et présenter des réponses à des appels à projets.

·         Négocier et contractualiser les accords fonciers et commerciaux.

·         Assurer le suivi des opportunités jusqu’à leur concrétisation et leur passage en phase de développement.

·         Contribuer à l’amélioration continue des outils, process et connaissances internes liés au développement territorial.

Votre profil

·         Formation Bac+5 : école de commerce, master en aménagement du territoire, urbanisme ou droit rural.

·         Expérience de 3 à 5 ans dans un rôle similaire (prospection foncière, développement ENR ou aménagement territorial).

·         Excellentes capacités relationnelles et de négociation.

·         Goût prononcé pour le terrain et le contact direct avec les acteurs locaux.

·         Esprit d’analyse, rigueur et autonomie dans la gestion de projets.

·         Motivation à évoluer dans un secteur porteur et en pleine transformation.

 

Ce que NOVAR vous offre

Chez Novar, nous ne vous proposons pas seulement un emploi – nous vous invitons à rejoindre une véritable aventure. Vous travaillerez dans un environnement entrepreneurial et innovant, où l’énergie est au cœur de tout – au sens propre comme au sens figuré. Aux côtés de professionnels passionnés, vous contribuerez concrètement à la mise en œuvre de systèmes énergétiques durables. Et qu’est-ce que cela vous apporte ?

💰 Un salaire attractif, compris entre 48 060 € et 62 383 €, en fonction de votre expérience et de votre parcours.
🎁 Un système de primes basé sur la performance.
🌴 Une prime vacances.
🩺 Mutuelle famille financée à 50% 
🚗 Une voiture de fonction.
🏠 Un mode de travail flexible et hybride – dans nos bureaux modernes ou confortablement depuis chez vous.
📚 Des opportunités de développement professionnel dans le domaine du stockage d’énergie par batteries (BESS).
🏆 Un voyage collectif annuel avec l’ensemble du groupe Novar, une expérience inoubliable – travailler dur et célébrer ensemble.

À propos de Novar – Nous façonnons l’avenir énergétique de l’Europe

Chez Novar, nous croyons que l’avenir de l’énergie est vert – et nous le concrétisons. Depuis notre création en 2014 aux Pays-Bas, nous sommes devenus un acteur majeur du développement et de l’exploitation de grandes installations d’énergies renouvelables. Avec plus de 150 collaborateurs engagés et 800 MWc de capacité installée, nous faisons avancer la transition énergétique à pleine vitesse. 

 

Ce qui a commencé par des centrales solaires au sol est devenu une entreprise énergétique complète. Aujourd’hui, nous développons et fournissons de l’énergie solaire, du stockage par batteries, du solaire thermique, de l’hydrogène, des réseaux intelligents et bien plus encore. Nous couvrons toute la chaîne de valeur – du développement et de la construction à la gestion de l’énergie et à l’innovation. 

 

Depuis 2024 nous étendons nos activités au-delà de notre marché d’origine, avec une présence en Suède, en Allemagne et en France. Notre objectif est ambitieux : développer 4 gigawatts de systèmes énergétiques verts d’ici 2030. Chez Novar, vous rejoindrez une équipe internationale en pleine croissance, animée par la volonté de faire la différence. Nous ne construisons pas seulement des projets énergétiques – nous façonnons les systèmes énergétiques de demain.

Prêt(e) pour la prochaine étape de votre carrière ? Postulez dès maintenant via le formulaire de candidature sur notre site internet et contribuez à créer un avenir plus durable !

  • Proactively investigate ad-hoc business issues to deliver timely, context-aware diagnosis and guidance.

    👉 PRÉ REQUIS

  • 5+ years as a Data Analyst with strong specialization in CRM analytics

  • Technical Skills 

  • Proficiency in SQL for data analysis, encompassing the full data lifecycle from retrieval to results presentation.

  • DBT skills

  • Familiarity with CRM tracking tools and data architectures 

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

  • Excellent communication and Proven presentation &report writing skills

  • A strong appetite for supervising projects and people

jobs.title: Technicien Maintenance & Métrologie
jobs.description:
A propos du poste :

Rejoignez Excelya, où Audace, Bienveillance et Énergie sont au cœur de notre façon de travailler. Nous favorisons un environnement collaboratif dans lequel chacun peut développer son expertise et contribuer à des projets à forte valeur ajoutée dans le secteur des Life Sciences.

Dans le cadre d’une mission au sein d’un environnement industriel pharmaceutique et dermo-cosmétique, nous recherchons un(e) Technicien(ne) Métrologie & Conformité.

Intégré(e) au service Utilités & Métrologie, vous contribuez au suivi et à la fiabilité du parc d’appareillage scientifique du site. Votre rôle est de garantir la conformité, la fiabilité et la sécurité des équipements, tout en assurant le suivi des interventions de métrologie et de maintenance.

Missions Principales :

  • Assurer la gestion, le suivi et la mise à jour du parc d’équipements et d’appareils de mesure ;
  • Planifier et réaliser les contrôles et vérifications métrologiques périodiques des équipements ;
  • Participer au suivi et à la vérification des installations liées au traitement d’air, CVC et HVAC ;
  • Réaliser ou coordonner les opérations de maintenance et de métrologie, en collaboration avec les utilisateurs et les prestataires externes ;
  • Analyser les pannes, dysfonctionnements et non-conformités, assurer leur suivi et contribuer à la mise en œuvre des actions correctives ;
  • Analyser les rapports de contrôle et vérifier la conformité des prestations réalisées ;
  • Réaliser des essais techniques et comparatifs afin de développer ou d’améliorer les méthodes de contrôle métrologique ;
  • Rédiger, mettre à jour et déployer les procédures métrologiques et organisationnelles ;
  • Assurer la traçabilité des interventions ainsi que la mise à jour des informations relatives aux équipements dans les outils de gestion dédiés ;
  • Collaborer avec les différents services afin d’analyser les prestations réalisées, d’identifier les nouveaux besoins et de garantir le maintien en conformité du parc

Requirements

À propos de vous

Chez Excelya, nous encourageons chacun à faire preuve d'audace et à développer son potentiel. Nous recherchons des professionnels partageant nos valeurs et souhaitant évoluer dans un environnement stimulant.

  • Expérience : Vous disposez d’au moins 3 ans d’expérience sur des activités de métrologie, maintenance, instrumentation ou suivi d’équipements, idéalement dans un environnement industriel réglementé.
  • Compétences techniques : Vous maîtrisez les activités de métrologie et de vérification périodique, ainsi que le suivi d’un parc d’équipements. Des connaissances en traitement d’air / CVC / HVAC, maintenance et analyse de pannes sont appréciées.
  • Qualité et conformité : Vous êtes à l’aise avec l’identification et le traitement des non-conformités, l’analyse de rapports de contrôle et la gestion documentaire associée.
  • Outils : Vous maîtrisez les outils bureautiques, notamment Excel. La connaissance d’un logiciel de gestion de la métrologie, notamment Optimu, constitue un plus.
  • Référentiels : La connaissance des normes ISO 9001 et ISO 10012, ainsi que des exigences réglementaires liées à la métrologie, est appréciée.
  • Formation : Vous êtes issu(e) d’une formation technique Bac+2 à Bac+3 en métrologie, mesures physiques, instrumentation, maintenance industrielle ou domaine équivalent.
  • Qualités personnelles : Vous êtes reconnu(e) pour votre rigueur, votre autonomie et votre sens de l’organisation. Votre esprit d’analyse, vos qualités relationnelles et rédactionnelles et votre capacité à travailler avec différents interlocuteurs seront essentiels pour réussir dans cette mission.
  • Permis B requis.

Benefits

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?

Chez Excelya, nous associons passion pour la science et esprit d'équipe afin de redéfinir l'excellence dans le secteur de la santé.

Ce qui nous distingue :

Nous sommes une entreprise de santé ambitieuse réunissant plus de 900 collaborateurs à travers l'Europe, avec l'objectif de devenir le leader européen des CRO de taille intermédiaire tout en offrant la meilleure expérience collaborateur.

Notre modèle de services intégré, combinant conseil, Functional Service Provider et Full Service, vous permettra d'évoluer sur des projets variés et à forte valeur ajoutée. Vous travaillerez aux côtés d'experts reconnus et contribuerez concrètement à l'amélioration du parcours patient.

Exceller avec bienveillance

Chez Excelya, la bienveillance est au cœur de nos actions. Nous favorisons l'égalité des chances et construisons un environnement de travail diversifié, équitable et inclusif, où chacun peut s'épanouir, être reconnu et contribuer pleinement à une mission commune.

Vos défis deviennent notre mission collective. Ensemble, nous transformons les idées ambitieuses en réalisations concrètes, à la manière d'Excelya.

Rejoignez-nous aujourd’hui et devenez un Excelyate !

jobs.title: Head of Hardware
jobs.description:
Accelerating embodied AGI.

The next ten years of AI will not be won in software. They will be won in the physical world: in factories, hospitals, kitchens, fields, and homes. The companies that own that data will own the century.

MicroAGI is building it. We are a data research and deployment lab. Atlas captures the manual work inside Europe’s industrial champions, trains foundation models on it, and deploys the right robot onto the floor, with no teleoperation and no interruption to the line. Shift records how physical work actually happens and turns it into training-ready data.

We were founded by former Formula 1 engineers from Red Bull Racing and Mercedes, together with a researcher from the Alan Turing Institute. Our $55M seed round, the largest in German history, was led by Hummingbird with Northzone, LocalGlobe, Village Global, and redalpine. We are based in Munich, with our research centre in Zürich and teams in London, New York, and Istanbul. We are now building the engineering and research teams that will take Atlas into new industries.

Our models learn from data captured in the physical world, by hardware we design and build ourselves. As Head of Hardware, you own that hardware end to end: electrical, firmware, and the mechanical integration that holds it together, from the first schematic to devices running on factory floors.

You lead the team that builds it. Today that is about six engineers on robotics, three on EMG sensing, and three on camera systems, plus contractors, and it will grow quickly. Our Electrical Engineer and Embedded Engineer roles report to you. You set the architecture they build against, and you still build alongside them.

This is a founder-shaped role, not a management seat. We are looking for someone who has carried a product from a blank page to customers with real skin in the game, wants to build both the thing and the team that builds it, and would rather design than review. If that sounds like you, you will want to do it again at the earliest stage.

What You Will Do

  • Own the hardware roadmap for Shift and Atlas data capture: wearables, sensor rigs, camera systems, and prototype robots. What we build, in what order, and why.

  • Set the system architecture across electrical, firmware, and mechanical: sensors, compute, power, wireless, and enclosures. Make the trade-offs, and make them stick when disciplines disagree.

  • Stay on the bench: schematics, layout reviews, board bring-up, and a scope in your hands when the team is stuck. On the days it matters, you are the best electrical engineer in the room.

  • Lead and grow the team: hire, set the bar, run design reviews, and give engineers ownership of whole subsystems rather than tickets.

  • Guarantee data quality end to end: EMG and EEG front ends, camera pipelines, IMUs, and synchronization across many devices, so that what reaches the ML team is clean, time-aligned, and trustworthy.

  • Take designs from prototype to small-batch production: DFM, component and EMS vendors, test fixtures, certification, and field reliability.

  • Work shoulder to shoulder with ML and deployment. Your hardware decides what the training data looks like, and you will be on the floor where it is captured.

  • Run contractors and partners without losing ownership of the result.

Requirements

  • You have taken at least one product from zero to shipped, with significant ownership of the outcome: as a co-founder, CTO, first hardware hire, or the lead who owned the whole device. Not one subsystem, not one phase. Ideally a wearable, at a tier-one hardware company known for shipping at scale.

  • Electrical engineering is your home discipline. You have designed boards that shipped, across mixed-signal, power, wireless, and high-speed digital, and you can still do it today.

  • You think in systems. You understand how an electrode choice, an enclosure tolerance, and an ADC sample rate interact, and you can hold the mechanical and firmware conversations as a peer, not a customer.

  • You have led engineers: hired them, grown them, and kept a team shipping through 0-to-1 ambiguity. Typically 6+ years in hardware, but we care more about what you shipped than how long it took.

  • A strong understanding of how hardware decisions affect data quality. You know that a great model on a noisy signal still loses to a decent model on a clean one, and you design accordingly.

  • Experience taking hardware to small-batch production: DFM, vendor and EMS management, test, and certification.

  • Genuinely curious about ML: you read papers, you have trained at least one model end to end, and you understand that dataset quality beats model architecture choice.

  • High agency: you don't wait to be told what to do. A 0-to-1 hardware program takes the hours it takes, in person and at pace, and you have chosen that before.

  • Discreet: you handle confidential hardware roadmaps and customer data with care.

Nice to Have

  • Wearables, smartwatches, drones, robotics, AR/VR, or defense wearables on your résumé.

  • Camera systems: sensor selection, MIPI and ISP pipelines, and multi-camera synchronization.

  • Low-power and battery design, BLE or Wi-Fi, and antenna integration in small enclosures.

  • Enough mechanical fluency (CAD, tolerances, and materials) to challenge the mechanical team’s choices and be right some of the time.

  • Prior founder or founding-engineer experience, including the parts that went wrong.

  • Open-source hardware or firmware contributions.

Who Will Thrive at MicroAGI

Everyone we hire is assessed on the same four traits:

  • Mission and vision: you care about what we are building and why it matters, and your past choices show it.

  • Intensity: you work at a pace that matches the size of the opportunity, and you sustain it.

  • Entrepreneurial: you start things nobody asked for, and you finish them.

  • Raw IQ: you learn fast, reason from first principles, and get sharper when the problem changes.

This is for you if:

  • You would rather own a problem end to end than wait for a spec.

  • You use AI every day, and you can tell a correct answer from a plausible one.

  • You want to work in person, in the office, with people who are very good at what they do.

This is not for you if:

  • You are looking for a predictable 9-to-5.

  • You would forward output you cannot explain.

  • "That’s not my job" feels like a reasonable answer.

How We Hire

We read every application and reply within five working days.

  1. Talent Screen (30 min): a first conversation, both ways.

  2. Technical or Functional Interview (60 min): how you think when the problem changes.

  3. Your Work (60 min): bring something you are proud of and walk us through it.

  4. Leadership (30 min): a conversation with our CEO.

  5. Coworking Day (engineering and research roles): a day building with the team on a real problem.

Then a decision, usually within a few days.

Pay Transparency

Compensation includes base salary and equity. The salary range for this role is shown on this posting.

What We Offer

  • Agency: real ownership from day one, and decisions that actually matter.

  • Freedom: to choose how you solve the problem, without layers of approval.

  • A seat on a rocketship: one of Europe’s fastest-growing deep-tech companies, at the earliest stage.

  • Free food and drinks in the office.

Equal Opportunity

MicroAGI welcomes applications from everyone. We assess candidates on their work and potential, regardless of ethnic origin, gender, religion or belief, disability, age, or sexual identity.

jobs.title: Executive Assistant
jobs.description:
This is Cradle

Proteins are the molecular machines of life, used for many therapeutic, diagnostic, chemical, agricultural and food applications. Designing and optimizing proteins takes a lot of expert knowledge and manual effort, through the use of custom computational and biological tools.

Machine learning is revolutionizing this space, by enabling high-fidelity protein models. At Cradle, we offer a software platform for AI-guided discovery and optimization of proteins, so that biologists can design proteins faster and at scale. We are already used by clients across biopharma, biotech, agri-tech, food-tech, and academia.

We're an experienced team of just under 100 people. We've built many successful products before and have enough funding for multiple years of runway. We are distributed across three offices in Amsterdam, Boston, and Zurich, alongside a few remote colleagues.

We offer our employees a very competitive salary, a generous equity stake in the company and a wide range of benefits and career progression opportunities.

The Role

As Executive Assistant at Cradle, you'll keep two of our founding executives moving. Between customer visits, investor meetings, hiring and travel across Amsterdam, Zurich and the US, there's a lot to keep track of, and your job is to make sure nothing gets dropped. You'll own their calendars, inboxes and travel, and take care of the personal admin that would otherwise eat into their time. This role suits someone who likes being trusted with the whole picture, professional and personal, and treats both with the same care.

Responsibilities

  • Run two calendars as one system: Protect focus time, balance competing priorities across time zones, and decide what deserves a meeting and what can be an email.

  • Own the inbox front line: Triage, draft and reply on their behalf to customers, investors, candidates and the team, so the important things surface and the rest gets handled.

  • Plan travel end to end: Customer visits, conferences and trips between Amsterdam, Zurich and the US, from flights and hotels to the meeting room and dinner booking on the other side.

  • Take care of personal and life admin: Appointments, household logistics, official paperwork, bills and renewals, handled so none of it lands on their desks.

  • Prepare every important meeting: Make sure briefs and context are ready beforehand, and follow up on decisions and action items afterwards.

  • Make recurring admin disappear: Automate repeated processes so they mostly run themselves.

Requirements

The best people we've hired didn't match a checklist. Below is a list of what matters most for this role. If you bring most of it and are curious about the rest, we'd love to hear from you:

  • 4+ years supporting senior executives, ideally more than one at a time

  • Sharp judgment about what's urgent, what can wait and what never needs to reach the exec

  • Clear, polished written English

  • You spot the next problem before anyone asks and fix it

  • Experience handling personal admin alongside the professional side, with the discretion that comes with it

  • Organised and dependable without needing a rigid structure; at a ~90-person company you'll often build the process yourself

  • At home in Google Workspace and quick to pick up new software tools

Nice to Haves

These aren't requirements, but they'd give you a head start:

  • German fluency would be idea to would make local appointments, paperwork and authorities much easier

  • Experience in a startup or scale-up environment

  • Familiarity with Swiss administrative procedures (permits, insurance, tax paperwork, relocations)

  • Experience with task tools like Todoist, Notion or Linear

Our commitment to inclusive hiring

Cradle evaluates all candidates based on merit, regardless of sex, gender, ethnicity, socio-economic background, or any other aspect of identity. We maintain zero tolerance for discrimination and actively encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply.

AI disclosure

Cradle uses an applicant tracking system that includes basic AI-assisted features which may generate scores or rankings based on how applications match a job description. These outputs are not used to make or meaningfully influence hiring decisions — all candidates are evaluated through a thorough, human-led review by our recruiting team.

A notice about recruitment scams

Please be aware that scammers are posing as us in order to get your personal details or money. We only communicate via @cradle.bio email addresses, we only make job offers after having met you in person at our office in Zurich or Amsterdam, and we never ask you to pay for anything during the interview process.

jobs.title: Storyteller: Freelance B2B Interviewer and Writer
jobs.location: EMEA or APAC time zones only
jobs.description:
About the Role

Elite Editing is seeking experienced freelance journalists and content professionals to support our growing customer reference and case study programs. We call this our Storyteller role, and we are specifically looking for experienced professionals based in EMEA and APAC time zones.

Our Storytellers own the storytelling process from interview through finished draft. They lead kickoff calls with our clients and their internal stakeholders, interview their customers and subject matter experts (SMEs), identify the strongest narrative angles within the information they gather, and then write compelling case studies and customer reference stories that adhere to client-specific standards and style guides.

This is more than simply working through a list of prepared questions—or turning a transcript into copy. We need skilled storytellers who listen closely, recognize when an answer deserves further exploration, ask intelligent follow-up questions, identify the details that make a story worth telling, and then shape that material into polished, engaging content.

Our ideal freelancer has a journalism or professional interviewing background paired with extensive professional writing experience and strong editorial judgment. You should be comfortable speaking with senior business leaders, technical SMEs, and other professionals; able to quickly understand unfamiliar or complex subject matter; and skilled at transforming what you learn into a clear and compelling narrative.

What You'll Do

You will:

  • Conduct virtual kickoff calls with client stakeholders to understand the goals, context, audience, and desired direction of customer reference stories.
  • Conduct virtual interviews with our clients' customers and SMEs, often involving senior-level or highly technical professionals.
  • Review project background materials and prepare for interviews in advance.
  • Use provided interview guides as a starting point while adapting questions to the conversation.
  • Ask thoughtful, unscripted follow-up questions that uncover meaningful details, examples, outcomes, challenges, and quotable insights.
  • Identify and develop the strongest story angles from interviews, background materials, and client input.
  • Write polished B2B case studies and customer reference stories based on the information you gather, following client-specific briefs, templates, standards, and style guides.
  • Synthesize complex or technical information into accurate, accessible, and engaging narratives for the intended audience.
  • Maintain a professional, confident, and personable presence while representing Elite and our clients on calls.
  • Work collaboratively with Elite's project managers, editors, and other members of the content team throughout the development and revision process.
  • Follow client-specific processes, confidentiality requirements, and project instructions.

Job Requirements

Successful candidates must:

  • Have substantial professional writing experience, with a portfolio demonstrating the ability to develop clear, engaging, publication-ready content.
  • Have professional experience conducting interviews, preferably in journalism, B2B content, tech, publishing, corporate communications, or a related field.
  • Be located in EMEA or APAC time zones.
  • Have excellent spoken and written English and exceptional verbal communication skills.
  • Be an exceptional listener who can think on their feet and pursue useful lines of questioning in real time.
  • Be comfortable interviewing senior executives, business leaders, customers, and subject matter experts.
  • Be able to absorb unfamiliar information quickly and ask credible, informed questions about complex topics.
  • Have strong editorial judgment and be able to identify the narrative, details, and supporting evidence that will make a compelling story.
  • Be able to synthesize interviews, transcripts, background materials, and client input into a cohesive finished piece.
  • Be highly reliable, organized, responsive, and comfortable working within established processes and deadlines.
  • Have a professional remote-work setup, including reliable high-speed internet and high-quality audio/video capabilities.

Preferred Qualifications

We're especially interested in candidates with one or more of the following:

  • A professional journalism background, particularly experience developing reported stories from initial research and interviews through finished copy.
  • Experience interviewing executives and subject matter experts.
  • Experience with B2B technology, enterprise technology, SaaS, cloud computing, professional services, or other complex industries.
  • Experience developing customer stories, customer reference content, case studies, thought leadership, or other long-form B2B content.
  • Experience working with or for a content, marketing, communications, or creative agency.
  • Familiarity with agency workflows in which freelancers work as part of a larger client delivery team.
  • Experience conducting interviews and developing content on behalf of major brands or enterprise organizations.
  • The ability to make interview subjects feel comfortable while keeping conversations focused and productive.

Prior agency experience is helpful but not required. We are much more interested in finding outstanding storytellers with excellent interviewing skills, writing ability, editorial judgment, curiosity, and professionalism.

Freelance Relationship

This is a freelance opportunity rather than a full-time staff position. Work will be offered based on project needs, Storyteller availability, subject-matter fit, and time zone.

Elite manages the broader client relationship, project workflow, and content production process. Freelancers work within established project parameters and compensation structures and collaborate with Elite's internal team and other content professionals to deliver the work.

Because interviews are scheduled with clients and their customers, this work requires the ability to commit to agreed-upon call times and arrive fully prepared.

About Elite Editing

Elite Editing is a woman-owned, fully remote strategic content agency based in Baltimore, Maryland. Founded in 2008, Elite began as an editing company and has grown into a full-service content partner supporting organizations with content strategy, writing, editing, marketing and sales enablement, AI implementation, and program management.

Our clients range from small businesses, publishers, agencies, universities, and thought leaders to some of the world's leading enterprise organizations. Our global network of writers, editors, interviewers, project managers, and other content professionals helps clients create high-quality content at scale.

Elite's approach is highly collaborative. We build specialized teams around our clients and integrate our processes with theirs, supporting everything from kickoff and research through SME interviewing, writing, editing, and final delivery.

We're serious about quality, but we're equally serious about being good people to work with. Our culture emphasizes trust, adaptability, collaboration, high standards, and finding a way to say "yes" to challenging work.

Who We'd Love to Hear From

You may be an especially strong fit if you've spent part of your career as a journalist and have since moved into freelance B2B, corporate, or branded content—or if you continue to work in journalism while taking on select commercial assignments.

If you know how to interview people well, recognize the story hiding within a conversation, and turn that raw material into compelling finished content, we'd like to hear from you.

jobs.title: Senior SEO & Organic Growth Strategist
jobs.description:
Ready to shape the future of B2B SaaS SEO while working with some of the fastest-growing companies in tech?

If you're equally passionate about driving strategic SEO initiatives and building strong senior client relationships, we want to talk to you.

We're looking for an SEO Strategist who can lead client conversations, turn SEO complexity into clear business recommendations, and confidently explain what matters, why it matters, and what should happen next.

Our Mission at Powered by Search

We exist to make B2B SaaS companies unstoppable.

We're on a mission to be the best in the world at SaaS marketing — doing work we love, with people we like, how we want.

The Opportunity

As a trusted advisor to fast-growing B2B SaaS companies, you'll join an elite team rated 5/5 ★★★★★ on Glassdoor, where 99% of team members recommend us to their peers.

This is a client-facing strategic SEO role. You won’t just be auditing websites or creating recommendations in isolation. You’ll be expected to lead conversations, explain tradeoffs, guide clients toward decisions, and connect SEO work to business outcomes.

You'll have the freedom to:

  • Drive holistic SEO strategies that deliver measurable business impact
  • Build strong, strategic relationships with SaaS marketing leaders
  • Shape the future of SEO in an AI-first search landscape
  • Work with a team that values strategic thinking as much as technical expertise
  • Own client outcomes through clear strategy, communication, and follow-through

What Sets You Apart

You're an ideal fit if you:

  • Can lead senior client conversations with clarity, confidence, and commercial judgment
  • Translate technical SEO insights into plain-English business recommendations
  • Connect SEO initiatives to pipeline, revenue, retention, and client priorities
  • Build trust with clients by communicating clearly, proactively, and directly
  • Get energized by analyzing data and uncovering actionable insights
  • Know how to turn messy SEO data into a clear story and next steps
  • Are comfortable challenging assumptions, clarifying tradeoffs, and guiding clients toward decisions
  • Love staying ahead of emerging SEO trends, especially in AI and semantic search
  • Embrace our core values:
    • Give a Sh!t
    • Always Be in It To Win It
    • Be Obsessed with Serving Others
    • Practice a Growth Mindset
    • When We Fail, We Don't Lose the Lesson

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Leadership — 40%

  • Develop comprehensive SEO strategies aligned with B2B SaaS business goals
  • Lead strategic client communications, monthly/quarterly reviews, and senior stakeholder conversations
  • Create and present clear performance narratives that explain results, tradeoffs, risks, and next actions
  • Turn data, rankings, traffic, pipeline, and conversion signals into practical SEO recommendations
  • Push client conversations toward decisions, priorities, and committed next steps
  • Drive innovation in AI-enhanced SEO strategies

Client Success — 40%

  • Manage and grow a portfolio of 3–5 B2B SaaS clients
  • Build trust with senior marketing, demand generation, product marketing, and executive stakeholders
  • Lead strategic planning sessions, performance reviews, and client calls with confidence
  • Proactively identify risks, opportunities, blockers, and next steps before the client has to ask
  • Own follow-through by making sure client conversations end with clear actions, owners, and timelines
  • Communicate progress, risks, and recommendations in a way clients can understand and act on

Technical Excellence — 20%

  • Guide technical SEO implementation and optimization
  • Identify technical, content, and authority-building opportunities that can improve organic performance
  • Develop and optimize conversion-focused SEO funnels
  • Integrate GA4, GTM, and reporting tools to generate useful performance insights
  • Recommend and guide advanced schema markup strategies
  • Prioritize SEO recommendations based on business impact, effort, and implementation realities

Required Experience

  • 5+ years of SEO experience, with at least 2 year focused on B2B SaaS
  • Previous experience in a client-facing SEO strategy role where you owned client communication, not just execution
  • Proven track record of driving organic growth for B2B or enterprise clients
  • Strong portfolio of successful client relationships and retention
  • Deep understanding of technical SEO, content strategy, analytics, and SEO performance measurement
  • Experience with GA4, GTM, and modern SEO tools
  • Excellent written and spoken English, with the ability to lead client calls, explain SEO recommendations clearly, and write concise client-ready updates
  • Strong judgment in prioritizing SEO work based on business impact, client context, and implementation realities
  • Ability to present performance, risks, opportunities, and next steps clearly to senior stakeholders

This Role May Not Be a Fit If

  • You prefer doing SEO execution without leading client conversations
  • You struggle to explain SEO concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders
  • You need someone else to turn your analysis into client-ready recommendations
  • You are uncomfortable challenging assumptions, clarifying tradeoffs, or guiding senior clients toward decisions
  • Your written or spoken English is not strong enough for live client-facing strategy conversations
  • You prefer being handed tasks rather than owning outcomes, priorities, and client follow-through

Why Join Us?

  • Work with a team that values strategic thinking and innovation
  • Competitive base salary plus quarterly performance bonuses
  • 5 weeks of paid time off
  • Fully remote work environment with flexible hours — you just need at least 4 hours of daily overlap with North American time zones
  • Comprehensive health spending account and eye/dental/medical benefits for Canadian residents
  • Regular team meetups and annual retreats
  • Clear career progression path without requiring a management track
  • Exposure to industry-leading B2B SaaS companies
  • Weekly 1:1 coaching with experienced managers
  • Access to proven playbooks, frameworks, and professional development opportunities

What Future Co-Workers Say

Here are some comments from your future co-workers about their experience at Powered by Search:

One of my life's best decisions was to join PBS. Here's why:

  • Working with top 1% SaaS experts
  • Supportive and empathetic leadership
  • End-to-end control with no account manager involvement
  • Highly data-driven and results-oriented
  • Remote-first with a supportive global team and flexible work hours
  • Your growth here in 1 year is similar to 3 to 4 years in other companies

Your Growth Journey

We believe in building our people so they can build the business.

You'll receive:

  • Weekly 1:1 coaching with experienced managers
  • Access to our proven playbooks and frameworks
  • Regular professional development opportunities
  • Exposure to industry-leading B2B SaaS companies
  • Clear feedback on how to grow as a strategist, communicator, and client leader

Ready to Help Make B2B SaaS Companies Unstoppable?

If you can combine SEO expertise, business judgment, and clear client communication, we’d love to hear from you.

jobs.title: Product Lead (Strategy + Full Stack)
jobs.description:
Do you want to join the company behind Northern Europe’s largest crypto and stock market comparison platforms? Do you want to own the product roadmap end to end and build it yourself? Do you want to decide what we build next as we expand globally?

We’re looking for a hands-on Product Lead to join our small but driven 100% remote team. This is a rare hybrid role: roughly 60% product leadership (roadmap, prioritization, specs, analytics) and 40% full stack development. You’ll work alongside our full-stack web developer, and as we expand the Product Team, your focus will shift increasingly toward product and team leadership, running 1-on-1s, recruiting, and building your own team to improve our products, with a clear path toward Head of Product.

Who are Optimizee Group?

Optimizee Group has been delivering results for 450+ partners worldwide through financial comparison platforms since 2017. Our portfolio includes CryptoRunner.com (the largest cryptocurrency comparison platform in Northern Europe), InvestoRunner.com (the largest stock market comparison platform in Sweden), and CreditRunner.com (a new credit card comparison platform launching soon).

Our mission is to build the world’s biggest and most trusted portfolio of financial comparison platforms, helping millions of people make better financial decisions. To date, we’ve generated over 8 million views and delivered more than 1.8 million referrals to our partners. With approximately 44,000 monthly active users and 35,000+ subscribers, you’ll have a strong existing audience and foundation to build on.

In 2026, we relaunched our websites on fully custom-built platforms, replacing our previous WordPress setup (see full tech stack below). The new platforms are connected to our in-house admin system, with integrations to multiple AI models and third-party API providers, giving us greater flexibility, scalability, and control as we grow. AI is deeply integrated into the admin system and across development, content, and operations. Over the past year we’ve shipped 970+ updates, and our product backlog holds 350+ tasks. Your job: review our platforms and product backlog, decide what to prioritize, and turn ideas into new features — with direct support from the founder, a former web developer who built our first platforms line by line.

Why Join Optimizee Group:

  • Be Part of a Market Leader – Help shape our established platforms, our group includes the largest stock and crypto comparison platforms in Northern Europe.
  • Full Ownership, Real Impact – High autonomy, meaningful ownership, and the opportunity to influence company decisions.
  • Join Early, Grow Faster – Join a small, fast-growing team where your role, responsibilities, and opportunities grow alongside the company.
  • Join an Ambitious Team – Work alongside high-performing teammates who value ownership, continuous improvement, and long-term thinking.

Benefits:

  • 🚀 Clear path to Head of Product as the team scales
  • 🤝 Work directly with the founder on strategy and growth
  • ⏰ High autonomy, flexible working hours, and strong ownership
  • 📈 Competitive compensation package + performance-based bonus
  • 🌎 Fully remote role — work from most countries worldwide
  • 🧰 All the AI and tools you need to do your best work
  • 💻 Home office setup — laptop and required equipment provided
  • ✈️ Annual business trips for team building, networking, and fun (past trips include Dubai, Singapore & Hong Kong)

Responsibilities:

  • Own the product roadmap across our platforms — prioritize, spec, and drive execution from idea to launch
  • Build and ship features hands-on alongside our web developer, improving site architecture, performance, and conversion flows
  • Lead and grow the product team — manage team members, run 1-on-1s and performance reviews, and take part in recruitment as we scale
  • Build our engineering workflow — set up development routines, code review, testing and deployment processes so multiple developers can ship safely, with documentation so knowledge is never siloed
  • Make data-first decisions — turn user data, market insights, and analytics into actions that move traffic, conversion, and revenue per visitor

Requirements:

  • 5+ years of full stack development experience — you can independently build, deploy, and maintain production web applications, and set up the workflows (Git, code review, CI/CD) for your team to do the same
  • A track record you can show — live products, sites, or projects you’ve built or led, and the ability to walk us through the decisions behind them
  • Strong backend, database, and architecture skills — data accuracy is critical to us, as we track and report statistics to 450+ partners
  • Proven product ownership with commercial instincts — you’ve decided what to build, not just built what was decided, and you understand how those decisions translate into revenue
  • Independent and async-first — you drive your own work in a small remote team and document decisions clearly in writing
  • Genuine interest in cryptocurrencies, investing, and personal finance — and high standards for what a great comparison platform looks like

Tech Stack:

  • Backend: PHP 8.2+ / Laravel 12 — one codebase powering the public sites and our in-house admin CMS/API
  • Frontend: Server-rendered Laravel Blade with Alpine.js, Livewire (admin), Tailwind CSS, and Vite — no React/Next.js
  • Database: MySQL, with Redis for cache, queues, and realtime (Laravel Reverb)
  • Infrastructure: Linux VPS with Nginx and PHP-FPM, automated deploys via GitHub Actions
  • Integrations: AI models via multiple providers (e.g. Anthropic, OpenAI, Google) plus third-party API integrations powering our platforms and admin system

Our Team Values:

  • Full Ownership – If you see it, you own it. Take full ownership from start to finish.
  • Data First – Data first, decision second. Always put data first before making decisions.
  • Long Game – We are building for decades, not quarters. Always play the long game.
  • AI Speed – The fastest teams win. Use AI to move like a team ten times our size.

Location & Availability:

This is a fully remote position; however, candidates should be able to maintain reasonable overlap with European business hours (CET/CEST) for meetings and team collaboration. We welcome applications from candidates worldwide, except residents of the United States.

Compensation:

USD 48,000–90,000 gross per year, consisting of a fixed base salary (USD 48,000–60,000, based on experience) and a revenue-tied performance bonus. You’ll receive paid time off and public holidays in line with the standards of your country of employment. Additional benefits and reimbursements may apply depending on your location. We employ through a global HR partner, enabling compliant employment in 95+ countries.

Apply:

Send in your application here: https://forms.gle/4yqiWvhiCMnC6xdx7

Hiring process: 1-minute intro video → intro call with the founder → portfolio walkthrough → offer. Applications reviewed continuously, start date by agreement.

See all available jobs here: https://optimizeegroup.com/#jobs

jobs.title: Face Deduplication Collection
jobs.description:
The objective of this project is to collect a large and diverse dataset of current neutral selfies, head-pose captures, and historical facial images to support machine-learning research and facial recognition model training at TELUS.

The focus is on capturing real-world variation across lighting, poses, expressions, accessories, environments, and aging to improve model accuracy and robustness. The collection includes:

• Current Neutral Selfies – clean frontal selfies serving as high-quality identity references, with natural variation in appearance and surroundings.

• Current Head-Pose Captures – selfies captured in assigned head directions to introduce pose variation.

• Historical Images – older photos from participants’ galleries to capture natural aging and long-term appearance changes.

The objective of this project is to collect a large and diverse dataset of current neutral selfies, head-pose captures, and historical facial images to support machine-learning research and facial recognition model training at TELUS.

To qualify for payment, you must submit a minimum of 20 valid images. The maximum payout is based on 24 accepted images. Due to the strict automated and manual Quality Control (QC) process, we strongly recommend submitting 30 images to help ensure that enough images remain valid after review

Note: Please use a Gmail address as your primary account when applying for this project.

 

Qualification path

No specific education is needed to perform the project task.

jobs.title: Senior Google Ads Account Manager - Remote (Work From Home)
jobs.location: Latin America, Europe, Canada, UK, South Africa
jobs.description:
Who we are

We are a team of hard-working marketers running a Premier Google Partner ad agency.

We help businesses large and small. Most of our clients are located in the United States, and our team members are located throughout the United States and around the world.

Check out our website: stubgroup.com

What we're looking for

We need a Senior Google Ads Account Manager! This is a remote (work-from-home) position.

Senior Google Ads Account Managers should possess:

  1. Advanced knowledge of Google Ads and how to create and manage profitable campaigns for ecommerce and lead-generation businesses.

  2. Strong client communication skills.

You will work directly with high-value clients as their primary point of contact and will be responsible for managing client relationships and creating and managing Google Ads campaigns for them.

Compensation & growth opportunities

At StubGroup, we have a milestone-based compensation structure that rewards our team members with increasing compensation as they generate more value for the company.

Starting Compensation: New Senior Google Ads Account Managers begin with a competitive monthly salary range of $4,000 - $5,000.

Bonuses and Incentives: Senior Google Ads Account Managers who go above and beyond may also earn additional bonuses and incentives aligned with the exceptional value they create for StubGroup.

We believe teamwork is the foundation of success, and we’re committed to recognizing and rewarding the outstanding contributions of our team members. Together, we grow and thrive!

The ideal candidate

Google Ads Knowledge: Proficiency in Google Ads is essential. You will be directly managing and overseeing high-value Google Ads campaigns for lead generation and ecommerce websites. You must be expert at using the Google Ads interface and Google Ads Editor, and have an advanced understanding of campaign structures, bidding strategies, conversion tracking, etc.

Marketing Strategy: Your responsibility is to learn about each client's business, including their products, target audience, and more. Your goal is to guide clients toward strategies that maximize the profitability of their ad campaigns. Whether it's recommending website changes or addressing a client's fixation on low click-through rates at the expense of website traffic quality and conversion rates, it's your job to educate them on more effective metrics for evaluating campaign success.

Problem-Solving: Our company values self-sufficiency and resourcefulness. We expect team members to "figure it out" and take initiative, rather than asking questions that could have been answered independently. Of course, we're here to provide support when you genuinely cannot solve a problem on your own. The expectation is that you will consistently go above and beyond, overcoming obstacles instead of letting them hinder your progress.

Make sure you’re comfortable with:

  • Remote working. This is a remote (work-from-home) position.

  • All job offers start with a 60-day trial to make sure that we’re the right fit for each other.

  • Communicating with business owners who don't understand how Google Ads works

  • Juggling a large number of tasks at a time and properly prioritizing how to handle them.

  • Working from 9:00 am - 5:00 pm Central Time (United States business hours)

Our values

Integrity: Honesty is vital. We must be honest with ourselves, with our colleagues, and with our clients. We tell clients exactly what we are doing for them, and what we can or can't do to help them. If we make a mistake, we own it.

Responsibility: We are here to solve problems for clients. We are constantly looking for ways to provide more value to our clients. How do we help them succeed? How do we help our colleagues succeed? We don't shirk work. We look for more of it. By being proactive, we stand out from the crowd and win our clients' trust.

Care: We're not just in this for the money. We genuinely want our clients to be successful. We understand that we're making an impact, that we are helping businesses create jobs and put food on the table for their families. We value that trust and do not abuse it.

To apply

If you're interested, please submit the following:

  • A link to your resume in PDF format with the following naming convention: [Lastname.Firstname.Senior-Manager.pdf]

  • Details of your experience

  • Your answer to this question: If you were an animal, what animal would you be and why?

  • Your answer to this question: I get up in the morning because . . .

Submissions should go to: john+senior+manager+nomads@stubgroup.com

I am looking for people who can format their submissions in a way that makes it easy for us to review. Remember, in client management, you want to help make it as easy on the client as possible! I’m happy to answer any questions you may include in your application.

Thank you for your consideration and best of luck with your job search!
